title_en: Cold War icon gets a new life: how Starfighters Space is repurposing the infamous F-104
title_zh: 冷战标志获得新生：Starfighters Space 如何重新利用臭名昭著的 F-104

summary_zh: F-104 在军事生涯中被称为“寡妇制造者”，现在可以成为飞行太空发射台。一架曾经因致命事故而令人担忧的飞机
body_en: Dubbed the “Widowmaker” during its military career, the F-104 could now become a flying space launchpad.
An aircraft once feared for its deadly accident record is finding new purpose as a platform for testing technologies at supersonic speeds and potentially launching rockets into space.
With its slender shape, unusually small wings and powerful engine, the Lockheed F-104 Starfighter was built for speed — a supersonic interceptor designed to operate at high altitudes.

When it entered US Air Force service in 1958, the Cold War-era jet was the first US fighter capable of sustained flight at more than twice the speed of sound, earning itself the nickname “missile with a man in it”. That same year, the Starfighter became the first aircraft to simultaneously hold official records for speed, altitude and time to climb.
Nearly 70 years later, a handful of Starfighters are still flying, although their missions have changed considerably.

Florida-based Starfighters Space operates a fleet of seven F-104s – some of the last airworthy Starfighters in the world. In the past month, the company announced several agreements to use its fleet to support aerospace and hypersonic testing, while also continuing to develop a system for launching space-bound rockets from an airborne F-104.

The idea is to use the F-104 to carry a rocket high into the atmosphere before releasing it, potentially reducing the amount of propellant needed in comparison to conventional ground-based rocket launches. The approach also allows the company to leverage the advantages of using an existing aircraft rather than take years to develop expensive new rockets.

“We’re not like most other aerospace launch companies. We’re not spending billions of dollars inventing new things with a huge amount of ground equipment,” Starfighters Space chief executive Tim Franta told FlightGlobal in an interview.
However, the company’s decision to rely on an ageing fighter jet with a notoriously dangerous history does not come without risks.

The unusual design of the F-104 Starfighter was the work of Lockheed engineer Clarence “Kelly” Johnson. At a time when fighter jets were becoming larger and more complex, Johnson decided to work against the grain, creating a small, lightweight fighter equipped with a high-thrust engine.

The result was an aircraft with short, exceptionally thin wings – each extending just 2.3m (7.5ft) from the body of the aircraft – designed to minimise drag at high speeds. The jet first flew on 4 March 1954.
But the same characteristics that made the Starfighter one of the fastest aircraft of its generation also contributed to its reputation as one of the most unforgiving.

The F-104 developed a notorious accident record, particularly while serving with the air force and navy of West Germany. Of the 916 Starfighters acquired by the country, 292 were lost in flying accidents, claiming the lives of 116 pilots.
As a result, the F-104 became known as the “Witwenmacher”, or “Widowmaker”.
Several factors contributed to the aircraft’s troubled history.

Early versions of the jet featured a downward-firing ejection seat, introduced partly because of concerns that an upward-firing seat could not safely clear the aircraft’s tall tail. However, engineers quickly realised that ejecting downwards at low altitude left pilots with too little time to deploy their parachutes.

According to US Air Force records, 21 F-104 pilots were killed in incidents involving the ejection system, and by 1960, efforts to replace the downward-firing seats with an upward-firing design were underway.

The aircraft’s small wings also presented challenges. While well suited for high-speed flight, they generated relatively little lift at lower speeds, meaning pilots had to maintain unusually high speeds during landing to keep the aircraft airborne.

Furthermore, although the F-104 was originally designed to intercept enemy aircraft at high altitudes, the West German Air Force used it for a wider range of missions, including low-level fighter-bomber operations, often in difficult weather conditions.
Flying at high speeds close to the ground left pilots little room for error, leading to numerous crashes.
body_zh: F-104 在军事生涯中被称为“寡妇制造者”，现在可以成为飞行太空发射台。
一架曾经因其致命事故记录而令人担忧的飞机正在寻找新的用途，作为测试超音速技术并有可能将火箭发射到太空的平台。
洛克希德 F-104 星际战斗机拥有细长的外形、异常小的机翼和强大的发动机，专为速度而设计，是一种专为高空运行而设计的超音速拦截机。
1958年进入美国空军服役时，这架冷战时期的喷气式飞机是美国第一架能够以两倍音速以上持续飞行的战斗机，因此赢得了“载人导弹”的绰号。同年，星际战斗机成为第一架同时保持速度、高度和爬升时间官方记录的飞机。
近 70 年后，少数星际战斗机仍在飞行，尽管它们的任务发生了很大变化。
总部位于佛罗里达州的 Starfighters Space 运营着一支由七架 F-104 组成的机队——其中一些是世界上最后一批适航的星际战斗机。上个月，该公司宣布了几项协议，利用其机队支持航空航天和高超音速测试，同时继续开发从机载 F-104 发射太空火箭的系统。
这个想法是使用 F-104 将火箭运载到高空后再释放，与传统的地面火箭发射相比，可能会减少所需的推进剂用量。这种方法还使该公司能够利用现有飞机的优势，而不是花费数年时间来开发昂贵的新火箭。
“我们与大多数其他航天发射公司不同。我们不会花费数十亿美元和大量地面设备来发明新事物，”Starfighters Space 首席执行官蒂姆·弗兰塔 (Tim Franta) 在接受 FlightGlobal 采访时表示。
然而，该公司决定依赖一架有着众所周知的危险历史的老化战斗机的决定并非没有风险。
F-104 星际战斗机的独特设计是洛克希德公司工程师克拉伦斯·“凯利”·约翰逊的作品。当喷气式战斗机变得越来越大、越来越复杂时，约翰逊决定逆向发展，制造出一种配备高推力发动机的小型轻型战斗机。
结果是一架具有短而特别薄的机翼的飞机 - 每个机翼距离飞机机身仅延伸 2.3 m（7.5 英尺） - 旨在最大限度地减少高速时的阻力。这架喷气式飞机于 1954 年 3 月 4 日首飞。
但是，使星际战斗机成为同代中速度最快的飞机之一的相同特征也使其成为最无情的飞机之一。
F-104 创造了臭名昭著的事故记录，特别是在西德空军和海军服役期间。在该国采购的916架星际战斗机中，有292架因飞行事故而损失，导致116名飞行员丧生。
因此，F-104 被称为“Witwenmacher”或“Widowmaker”。
有几个因素导致了这架飞机的麻烦历史。
该喷气式飞机的早期版本采用向下发射的弹射座椅，部分原因是担心向上发射的座椅无法安全地离开飞机的高尾。然而，工程师们很快意识到，低空向下弹射导致飞行员展开降落伞的时间太少。
根据美国空军的记录，有 21 名 F-104 飞行员在涉及弹射系统的事故中丧生，到 1960 年，人们开始努力用向上发射的设计取代向下发射的座椅。
飞机的小机翼也带来了挑战。虽然它们非常适合高速飞行，但在较低速度下产生的升力相对较小，这意味着飞行员在着陆过程中必须保持异常高的速度才能保持飞机在空中。
此外，虽然 F-104 最初设计用于在高空拦截敌机，但西德空军将其用于更广泛的任务，包括低空战斗轰炸机行动，通常是在恶劣的天气条件下进行。
接近地面的高速飞行使飞行员几乎没有犯错的余地，从而导致了多次坠机事故。

title_en: Copa trims outlook as fuel costs impact margins
title_zh: 由于燃料成本影响利润率，Copa 下调前景
summary: The Panamanian carrier has aggressively expanded capacity in 2026. Copa Airlines has lowered its outlook for the year as fuel costs continue to pressure margins. The Latin American carrier reported an operating profit of $224 million for the third quarter, up
summary_zh: 这家巴拿马航空公司已在 2026 年积极扩大运力。由于燃油成本继续承压，巴拿马航空公司下调了今年的预期。
body_en: The Panamanian carrier has aggressively expanded capacity in 2026.
Copa Airlines has lowered its outlook for the year as fuel costs continue to pressure margins.

The Latin American carrier reported an operating profit of $224 million for the third quarter, up 5.7% year on year. Revenue jumped 32% year on year to $1.2 billion, but its operating margin fell to 19% from 23%.
“While demand trends across the network continue to be strong, fuel prices have increased relative to the assumptions incorporated in the company’s prior outlook,” Copa says.

Copa now expects an operating margin of 16-17% for the full year of 2026, down from the 17-19% prediction it made in August . Capacity growth for the year is still expected to be 14.5%, much higher than for many other global carriers.

Despite the aggressive growth strategy, load factors have remained high, growing 0.7 percentage points to 88.7%. Strong demand allowed Copa to recover 86% of higher fuel costs through revenue, up from about 40% in the second quarter.

“Copa’s proven business model, built on Panama’s strategic geographic position, industry-leading operational reliability, structurally low unit costs, a passenger-friendly product and a strong balance sheet, positions the company well to navigate periods of fuel price volatility while continuing to generate profitable growth and long-term shareholder value,” Copa says.
The airline expects growth to moderate to between 8-9% in 2027.
The post Copa trims outlook as fuel costs impact margins first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 这家巴拿马航空公司已在 2026 年积极扩大运力。
由于燃油成本继续对利润率构成压力，巴拿马航空下调了今年的预期。
这家拉丁美洲航空公司公布第三季度营业利润为 2.24 亿美元，同比增长 5.7%。收入同比增长 32% 至 12 亿美元，但营业利润率从 23% 下降至 19%。
科帕表示：“虽然整个网络的需求趋势继续强劲，但相对于公司先前展望中的假设，燃油价格有所上涨。”
Copa 目前预计 2026 年全年营业利润率为 16-17%，低于 8 月份预测的 17-19%。今年运力增长预计仍为 14.5%，远高于许多其他全球航空公司。
尽管采取了积极的增长策略，载客率仍然很高，增长了 0.7 个百分点，达到 88.7%。强劲的需求使 Copa 通过收入收回了 86% 的较高燃料成本，高于第二季度的 40% 左右。
Copa 表示：“Copa 成熟的商业模式建立在巴拿马的战略地理位置、行业领先的运营可靠性、结构性低单位成本、乘客友好的产品和强大的资产负债表之上，使该公司能够很好地应对燃油价格波动时期，同时继续产生盈利增长和长期股东价值。”
该航空公司预计 2027 年增长率将放缓至 8-9%。
由于燃油成本影响利润率，Copa 后下调前景的消息首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: FAA mandates Boeing 737NG checks over ‘thrust split monitor’ concern
title_zh: FAA 要求波音 737NG 检查“推力分离监视器”问题
summary: Spoiler-position data problems have potential to prevent activation of an autothrottle deactivation feature on 300 aircraft. The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered airlines to test some Boeing 737NGs in response to a problem that could preven
summary_zh: 扰流板位置数据问题可能会导致 300 架飞机无法激活自动油门停用功能。美国联邦航空A
body_en: Spoiler-position data problems have potential to prevent activation of an autothrottle deactivation feature on 300 aircraft.

The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered airlines to test some Boeing 737NGs in response to a problem that could prevent proper operation of a system designed to prevent asymmetric thrust from leading to uncommanded rolls.
A newly published airworthiness directive says autothrottle “cruise thrust split monitor” on 300 737NGs might not activate due to unavailable or erroneous spoiler position data.

The thrust split monitor is a safety feature designed to deactivate the autothrottle in cases of asymmetric thrust, which it detects based on thrust disparity and spoiler deployment. (The jets’ autopilot system can cause the spoilers to deploy when countering rolls, including those due to asymmetric thrust.)
“There is a potential for latent loss of spoiler sensor position data or erroneous spoiler sensor position data,” says the FAA’s order, published on 18 November.
The data problem could keep the thrust split monitor from responding to “significant throttle split”, leading to a roll that could become serious if not quickly addressed by the pilots.
The rule applies to a group of 737-600s, 737-700s, 737-800s and 737-900s.
Boeing addressed the concern in a 30 October Alert Safety Advisory that calls on operators to repeatedly test 737NG digital flight control systems. The FAA’s rule mandates those tests.

“Boeing notified the FAA in 2025 of a potential issue with the wiring in the autothrottle system on 737 Next-Generation airplanes built before January 2003,” Boeing tells FlightGlobal. “The issue has not been observed in service. We issued inspection guidance to operators in October 2026 and support the FAA making that guidance mandatory.”
The issue does not affect 737 Max, or 737NGs manufactured after January 2003, and the required inspections take about 1h to complete, Boeing adds.
The FAA issued the rule without following its typical process of first accepting public comments, saying an “unsafe condition” justifies swift action. It is now accepting public comments for 45 days.

The FAA has previously responded to issues with the split thrust monitor, and Indonesia investigators cited a delayed activation of the monitor as contributing to the deadly January 2021 upset and crash of a Sriwijaya Air 737-500.

In 2022, the FAA ordered operators of 737-300s through -500s to check for potential spoiler sensor failures that would escape detection by the thrust split monitor. The agency in 2024 issued another rule addressing concerns related to spoilers being unable to reach a deflection level
The post FAA mandates Boeing 737NG checks over ‘thrust split monitor’ concern first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 扰流板位置数据问题可能会导致 300 架飞机无法激活自动油门停用功能。
美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 已下令航空公司对部分波音 737NG 飞机进行测试，以解决可能妨碍旨在防止不对称推力导致非指令滚转的系统正常运行的问题。
新发布的适航指令称，由于扰流板位置数据不可用或错误，300 737NG 上的自动油门“巡航推力分离监视器”可能无法激活。
推力分离监视器是一项安全功能，旨在在推力不对称的情况下停用自动油门，它根据推力差异和扰流板部署进行检测。 （喷气式飞机的自动驾驶系统可能会导致扰流板在对抗滚转时展开，包括由于不对称推力而导致的滚转。）
美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 于 11 月 18 日发布的命令称：“扰流板传感器位置数据可能会潜在丢失，或者扰流板传感器位置数据可能会出现错误。”
数据问题可能会使推力分裂监视器无法响应“显着的油门分裂”，如果飞行员不迅速解决，可能会导致严重的滚转。
波音公司在 10 月 30 日发布的安全警报警报中解决了这一问题，呼吁运营商反复测试 737NG 数字飞行控制系统。美国联邦航空局的规则强制要求进行这些测试。
波音公司告诉 FlightGlobal：“波音公司于 2025 年向美国联邦航空局通报了 2003 年 1 月之前生产的 737 下一代飞机的自动油门系统接线可能存在的问题。” “在使用中尚未发现该问题。我们于 2026 年 10 月向运营商发布了检查指南，并支持 FAA 强制执行该指南。”
波音公司补充说，该问题不会影响 737 Max 或 2003 年 1 月之后生产的 737NG，并且所需的检查大约需要 1 小时才能完成。
美国联邦航空局在没有遵循首先接受公众意见的典型程序的情况下发布了该规则，称“不安全的情况”需要迅速采取行动。现接受公众意见，为期 45 天。
美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 此前曾对分体式推力监视器的问题做出过回应，印度尼西亚调查人员表示，监视器延迟激活是造成 2021 年 1 月三佛齐航空 (Sriwijaya Air) 737-500 飞机失事和致命事故的原因之一。
2022 年，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 命令 737-300 至 -500 的操作员检查潜在的扰流板传感器故障，这些故障可能会逃避推力分离监视器的检测。该机构于 2024 年发布了另一项规则，解决扰流板无法达到偏转水平的问题

title_en: Airbus advances towards Wing of Tomorrow flight-test phase
title_zh: 空中客车公司进入“明日之翼”飞行测试阶段
summary: Airframer plans to evaluate multiple wing-tip extensions to inform design of Next Generation Single-Aisle. Airbus has begun fabricating the first set of wing extensions it plans to flight test under its Wing of Tomorrow programme. Designed to simulate fully ex
summary_zh: Airframer 计划评估多个翼尖延伸部分，为下一代单通道飞机的设计提供信息。空中客车公司已开始制造第一套飞机
body_en: Airframer plans to evaluate multiple wing-tip extensions to inform design of Next Generation Single-Aisle.
Airbus has begun fabricating the first set of wing extensions it plans to flight test under its Wing of Tomorrow programme.

Designed to simulate fully extended folding wing-tips, they are part of the airframer’s strategy to develop ultra-efficient high-aspect-ratio wings for the Next Generation Single-Aisle (NGSA), an eventual successor to the A320neo family.
Airbus announced the wing-tip project in July, and Sue Partridge, head of Wing of Tomorrow, says so far it is “going really well”.

The airframer has already performed “a lot of work to prepare the test aircraft” for the installation – the wing-tips will replace the jet’s current ‘Sharklet’ structures – with design work on the multiple extensions also under way.

“We are very well advanced through the design of the extensions and we have already started the manufacture of the first extensions,” she told FlightGlobal at the UK Aerospace Technology Institute conference in South Wales on 17 November.
The extensions will be installed on the test aircraft in 2027, with a first flight to follow later that year.
Partridge says Airbus will test a “number of different iterations” of the wing-extensions – which simulate the folding tips in their ‘locked’ position – over the course of the flight-test campaign.
These feature different shapes, configurations and sub-configurations, she notes.
“It’s not an endless number because I haven’t got an endless amount of money but we are doing some different core shapes, but then we are looking at different iterations within that.”

Airbus has not set a limit on the number of flights it will perform with each iteration of wing-tip extensions but will continue “until we conclude all the learning that we want to get from that flight-test programme”.
Partridge hopes the flight-tests will be wrapped up in 2027 but says there is an option to continue into 2028 if required.

She declines to disclose how long each structure will be but says they are “in line” with the longer wing envisaged for the NGSA, broadening the A320neo’s 34m (112ft) span by around 4-5m on each side.

Meanwhile, load testing of a full-scale 17m-long demonstrator produced through Wing of Tomorrow continues at the airframer’s Aerospace Integrated Research & Test Centre site in Filton, near Bristol in southwest England.
This process, culminating in the testing-to-destruction of the wing, was meant to conclude later this year.
However, Partridge says the project’s destructive conclusion has been pushed back: “Having invested an awful lot in that asset, we are going to squeeze every bit of learning out of it.
“It’s back in testing right now, running load cases, and that will go on well into next year.”
Results to date have been “encouraging”, she says, and are “validating our predictions”.
Another two wing demonstrators were built as part of the programme, with the third, the ‘run-at-rate’ wing , completed earlier this year.

This demonstrator is designed to evaluate whether the all-composite structure can be built at a pace that could support the high rates envisaged for the NGSA and what place automation has in the process.
body_zh: Airframer 计划评估多个翼尖延伸部分，为下一代单通道飞机的设计提供信息。
空中客车公司已经开始制造第一组机翼延伸部分，并计划在“明日之翼”计划下进行飞行测试。
它们旨在模拟完全展开的折叠翼尖，是机身制造商为下一代单通道 (NGSA)（A320neo 系列的最终继任者）开发超高效高展弦比机翼战略的一部分。
空中客车公司于 7 月宣布了翼尖项目，明日之翼负责人苏·帕特里奇 (Sue Partridge) 表示，到目前为止，该项目“进展非常顺利”。
机身制造商已经为安装进行了“大量准备测试飞机的工作”——翼尖将取代飞机当前的“Sharklet”结构——多个扩展部分的设计工作也在进行中。
她在11月17日于威尔士南部举行的英国航空航天技术研究所会议上对FlightGlobal表示：“我们在翼尖延长翼的设计方面进展非常顺利，并且已经开始制造第一批翼尖延长翼。”
这些扩展装置将于 2027 年安装在测试飞机上，并于当年晚些时候进行首次飞行。
帕特里奇表示，空中客车公司将在飞行测试过程中测试机翼延伸部分的“多种不同版本”——模拟处于“锁定”位置的折叠尖端。
她指出，它们具有不同的形状、配置和子配置。
“这不是一个无穷无尽的数字，因为我没有无穷无尽的钱，但我们正在做一些不同的核心形状，但我们正在考虑其中的不同迭代。”
空中客车公司并未对翼尖延伸的每次迭代执行的飞行次数设定限制，但将继续“直到我们得出我们希望从飞行测试计划中获得的所有知识”。
帕特里奇希望飞行测试能够在 2027 年完成，但表示如果需要，可以选择继续到 2028 年。
她拒绝透露每个结构的长度，但表示它们与 NGSA 设想的较长机翼“一致”，将 A320neo 34m（112 英尺）的跨度每侧扩大约 4-5m。
与此同时，“明日之翼”生产的全尺寸 17m 长验证机的负载测试仍在英格兰西南部布里斯托尔附近菲尔顿的机身制造商航空航天综合研究与测试中心现场继续进行。
这一过程最终导致机翼的销毁测试，原定于今年晚些时候结束。
然而，帕特里奇表示，该项目的破坏性结论已被推迟：“在该资产上投入了大量资金后，我们将从中榨取每一点知识。
“它现在已经回到测试阶段，正在运行负载案例，这将持续到明年。”
她说，迄今为止的结果“令人鼓舞”，并且正在“验证我们的预测”。
作为该计划的一部分，另外建造了两个机翼演示机，第三个机翼“按速度运行”于今年早些时候完工。
该演示器旨在评估全复合结构的建造速度是否可以支持 NGSA 设想的高速率，以及自动化在该过程中的地位。

title_en: Abra profit grows as premium sales help offset fuel bill
title_zh: 由于溢价销售有助于抵消燃油费用，Abra 利润增长
summary: The Avianca and Gol parent returned to profitability although both carriers remained loss-making. Abra Group‘s push to raise fares and sell premium seats is paying off, the company’s third-quarter results suggest. For the period to end-September, the parent co
summary_zh: 尽管阿维安卡航空公司和戈尔航空公司的母公司都恢复盈利，但两家航空公司仍处于亏损状态。 Abra Group 推动提高票价并出售优质服务
body_en: The Avianca and Gol parent returned to profitability although both carriers remained loss-making.
Abra Group ‘s push to raise fares and sell premium seats is paying off, the company’s third-quarter results suggest.

For the period to end-September, the parent company of major Latin American carriers Avianca and Gol reported an operating profit of $293 million, up 5.6% year on year. Revenue rose 22% to $3.1 billion, boosted by higher fares.

“We delivered solid third-quarter results with continued revenue growth, disciplined execution and strong performance across our passenger, cargo and other businesses,” says Abra chief executive Adrian Neuhauser.

Abra does not give financial guidance, but says it will keep making tactical capacity adjustments to mitigate higher fuel prices. Avianca and Gol cut third-quarter capacity by 3% and 7%, respectively, against schedules set in February.
Premium revenue grew by 64% and made up 26% of passenger revenue in the quarter.

Fuel recapture — the degree to which Abra was able to pass on fuel costs to customers through higher fares — was 93%, up from 49% in the second quarter. The firm has retained some hedging, covering about 44% of its fourth-quarter passenger fuel consumption at an average cap of $4.05 per gallon, and has extended coverage into the first quarter of 2027.

Abra also benefitted from a $182 million accounting gain on derivatives linked to its debt, which helped lift its net profit to $63.4 million from a $100 million loss a year ago. With interest, taxes, and foreign exchange costs included, both main airlines remained in the red.
Avianca posted a net loss of $36.9 million, compared with a $51.8 million profit a year earlier, while Gol’s net loss widened to $76.4 million from $3.6 million.
In October, Neuhauser confirmed plans for an initial public offering (IPO), but noted that market volatility made the exact timing difficult.

“Our co-ordinated approach to fuel mitigation demonstrated our ability to effectively manage external volatility in the current environment, while continuing to invest for long-term growth,” Neuhauser says.

body_zh: 尽管阿维安卡航空公司和戈尔航空公司的母公司都恢复盈利，但两家航空公司仍处于亏损状态。
Abra Group 第三季度业绩显示，该公司提高票价和出售高级座位的努力正在取得成效。
截至9月底，拉丁美洲主要航空公司Avianca和Gol的母公司报告营业利润为2.93亿美元，同比增长5.6%。受票价上涨的推动，收入增长 22% 至 31 亿美元。
Abra 首席执行官阿德里安·诺伊豪瑟 (Adrian Neuhauser) 表示：“我们在客运、货运和其他业务方面实现了稳健的第三季度业绩，收入持续增长，执行严格，表现强劲。”
Abra 没有提供财务指导，但表示将继续进行战术产能调整，以缓解燃油价格上涨的影响。 Avianca 和 Gol 分别比 2 月份设定的计划削减了第三季度运力 3% 和 7%。
本季度保费收入增长 64%，占客运收入的 26%。
燃油回收率（Abra 能够通过提高票价将燃油成本转嫁给客户的程度）为 93%，高于第二季度的 49%。该公司保留了一些对冲，以每加仑 4.05 美元的平均上限覆盖了第四季度约 44% 的客运燃料消耗，并将覆盖范围延长至 2027 年第一季度。
Abra 还受益于与其债务相关的衍生品的 1.82 亿美元会计收益，这有助于将其净利润从一年前的 1 亿美元亏损提升至 6,340 万美元。算上利息、税收和外汇成本，两家主要航空公司仍处于亏损状态。
Avianca 公布净亏损 3690 万美元，而上年同期利润为 5180 万美元，而 Gol 的净亏损则从 360 万美元扩大至 7640 万美元。
10 月，诺伊豪瑟确认了首次公开募股 (IPO) 的计划，但指出市场波动使得确切的时机变得困难。
“我们协调一致的燃油减排方法表明，我们有能力在当前环境下有效管理外部波动，同时继续为长期增长进行投资，”诺伊豪瑟说。
随着溢价销售帮助抵消燃油费用，Abra 后利润增长首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Corrosive gallium, axe used to sabotage C-130H at Shannon airport: US authorities
title_zh: 美国当局在香农机场破坏 C-130H 时使用了腐蚀性镓和斧头
summary: US officials say ‘severe’ damage was inflicted upon the transport aircraft, leaving it inoperable. The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has indicted an Irish man in connection with destruction of a US military transport aircraft. Daithi O’Corrain was charged wit
summary_zh: 美国官员表示，运输机遭到“严重”损坏，无法运行。美国司法部 (DOJ) 已起诉
body_en: US officials say ‘severe’ damage was inflicted upon the transport aircraft, leaving it inoperable.
The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has indicted an Irish man in connection with destruction of a US military transport aircraft.

Daithi O’Corrain was charged with destroying government property, which carries a maximum sentence of 10 years in prison, after allegedly damaging a US Air Force Lockheed Martin C-130H transport aircraft making a stopover in Ireland.

The incident occurred on 11 April at Shannon airport in County Clare, Ireland, which is used by the Pentagon as a refuelling stop and logistics hub for military aircraft transiting from North America to the Middle East. According to the United States Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York (SDNY), O’Corrain breached the security perimeter at Shannon and gained forcible entry to the C-130H by forcing open the rear crew door while the aircraft was parked on a taxiway.

Once inside, O’Corrain inflicted “severe damage” to the interior of the aircraft, according to SDNY, including crimping a liquid oxygen line and destroying “every gauge” in the aircraft’s cockpit and puncturing air ducts. Photos included with the indictment show cracked gauges and screens on the C-130H’s instrument panel.

Prosecutors say O’Corrain also used capsules of gallium – described as a highly corrosive metal that is liquid at room temperature and “eats through aluminium in minutes” – to damage the C-130H’s aluminium structure.
Solid gallium liquifies at temperatures exceeding 30°C.

When the crew of the American aircraft returned several hours later, O’Corrain exited via an escape hatch on the upper fuselage and damaged the exterior airframe using an axe. He also poured ball bearings and an “unknown substance” into the transport’s fuel tanks.

“Daithi O’Corrain carried out a deliberate, planned attack against a US military aircraft, causing tens of millions of dollars in damage and jeopardising critical military operations,” says Federal Bureau of Investigation assistant director James Barnacle.

The DOJ says the attack required “months of planning and preparation”, including acquisition of materials and online research into both the layout of Shannon airport and the C-130H. O’Corrain “demonstrated a detailed knowledge of… how best to destroy critical components of the aircraft, which wires and components to cut and which not to cut, for his own personal safety”, the department adds.
“This was not an act of spontaneous vandalism,” Barnacle says.
As proof of that expertise, authorities cite the manner in which O’Corrain sabotaged the liquid oxygen system.
“Had O’Corrain cut, rather than crimped, the aircraft’s liquid oxygen line, as he had its wire bundles, there would have been a high chance of a massive explosion within the aircraft,” the DOJ notes.
Irish law enforcement apprehended O’Corrain at the scene.
The DOJ says the attack left the $60 million C-130H permanently inoperable; there are no plans to return it to flight status.

Many Irish residents oppose the US presence at Shannon, citing Washington’s support for Israel’s military operation in Gaza and Ireland’s longstanding policy of neutrality. There have been multiple protests at the airport and several attempts at vandalising or damaging aircraft.

In May 2025, three people were arrested by Irish authorities after driving a van through the Shannon airport perimeter fence; a few weeks later three people breached the runway at Shannon and sprayed a US military aircraft with paint, temporarily rendering it inoperable, according to the DOJ.
A similar breach occurred in November 2025, when three people were detained by airport security.

body_zh: 美国官员表示，运输机遭到“严重”损坏，无法运行。
美国司法部 (DOJ) 起诉一名爱尔兰男子涉嫌毁坏一架美国军用运输机。
Daithi O’Corrain 因涉嫌破坏一架在爱尔兰中途停留的美国空军洛克希德·马丁公司 C-130H 运输机而被指控破坏政府财产，最高可判处 10 年监禁。
这起事件于 4 月 11 日发生在爱尔兰克莱尔郡香农机场，该机场被五角大楼用作从北美飞往中东的军用飞机的加油站和后勤枢纽。据纽约南区美国检察官办公室 (SDNY) 称，奥科兰突破了香农机场的安全边界，并在飞机停在滑行道上时强行打开 C-130H 后机组门，强行进入了这架飞机。
据 SDNY 称，奥科兰一进入飞机内部就对飞机内部造成了“严重损坏”，包括卷曲液氧管线、毁坏了飞机驾驶舱内的“所有仪表”并刺穿了空气管道。起诉书中包含的照片显示 C-130H 仪表板上的仪表和屏幕破裂。
检察官称，奥科兰还使用镓胶囊来损坏 C-130H 的铝结构。镓被描述为一种高腐蚀性金属，在室温下呈液态，“几分钟内就会腐蚀铝”。
固体镓在温度超过 30°C 时会液化。
几小时后，当美国飞机的机组人员返回时，奥科兰从机身上部的逃生舱口逃了出来，并用斧头损坏了外部机身。他还将滚珠轴承和一种“未知物质”倒入运输工具的油箱中。
美国联邦调查局助理局长詹姆斯·巴纳克尔 (James Barnacle) 表示：“戴蒂·奥科兰 (Daithi O’Corrain) 对一架美国军用飞机进行了蓄意、有计划的袭击，造成了数千万美元的损失，并危及了关键的军事行动。”
美国司法部表示，这次袭击需要“数月的计划和准备”，包括采购材料以及对香农机场和 C-130H 的布局进行在线研究。该部门补充说，奥科兰“展示了关于……如何最好地摧毁飞机关键部件的详细知识，为了他自己的人身安全，哪些电线和部件应该剪断，哪些不应该剪断”。
“这不是自发的破坏行为，”巴纳克尔说。
作为这种专业知识的证据，当局引用了奥科兰破坏液氧系统的方式。
美国司法部指出：“如果奥科兰切断而不是卷曲飞机的液氧管线，就像他剪断线束一样，飞机内很可能会发生大规模爆炸。”
爱尔兰执法部门在现场逮捕了奥科兰。
美国司法部表示，此次攻击导致价值 6000 万美元的 C-130H 永久无法运行；目前尚无计划使其恢复飞行状态。
许多爱尔兰居民反对美国在香农的存在，理由是华盛顿支持以色列在加沙的军事行动以及爱尔兰长期以来的中立政策。机场发生多次抗议活动，并多次企图破坏或损坏飞机。
2025年5月，三人驾驶一辆货车冲过香农机场围栏后被爱尔兰当局逮捕；据美国司法部称，几周后，三人冲破香农机场跑道，向一架美国军用飞机喷漆，导致飞机暂时无法运行。
2025 年 11 月也发生过类似的违规事件，当时三人被机场保安拘留。
用于在香农机场破坏 C-130H 的后腐蚀镓斧头：美国当局首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Will last week’s ATC failure help the FAA get more money to replace old technology – or less?
title_zh: 上周的空中交通管制失败会帮助美国联邦航空局获得更多资金来更换旧技术，还是更少？
summary: Transportation secretary Sean Duffy this week asked Congress for $50 billion for ATC modernisation. Depending on who you ask, the USA’s 13 November air travel meltdown either reflects Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) mismanagement or reveals exactly why C
summary_zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 本周要求国会拨款 500 亿美元用于 ATC 现代化。美国 11 月 13 日的 AI 报告取决于你问的是谁
body_en: Transportation secretary Sean Duffy this week asked Congress for $50 billion for ATC modernisation.

Depending on who you ask, the USA’s 13 November air travel meltdown either reflects Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) mismanagement or reveals exactly why Congress should allocate billions more dollars for air traffic control (ATC) modernisation.
Perhaps both narratives have truth. Everyone can agree the US ATC system is hopelessly senile and that maintenance should never prompt a nationwide ground stop.

The meltdown happened as FAA contractor L3Harris was replacing copper wiring with fibre-optic cables. A new router was also installed, the agency said. The resulting technological hiccup (the cause remains unclear; an investigation is under way) degraded ATC communications, prompting the FAA to order a ground stop that lasted 4h and caused thousands of flight cancellations.

Department of Transportation secretary Sean Duffy seized the moment, describing the failure as exhibit A for why Congress should immediately fund complete ATC modernisation. Duffy even upped the ante, saying he actually needs $50 billion , not the previously estimated $30 billion.
President Trump added on Truth Social: “If Congress approves the desperately needed money for air traffic control, we can get it built quickly and efficiently.”

Meanwhile some Democrats accused Duffy of using the meltdown as “ransom” for more funding, while questioning the administration’s ability to manage such a sweeping project. New York governor Kathy Hochul called for Duffy’s resignation.

ATC failures are an American fact of life, more common than election cycles and totally non-partisan. (The FAA’s prior nationwide ground stop, in 2023 under the Biden administration, resulted from a NOTAM system outage.)

The Trump administration put momentum behind modernisation, making its “brand-new air traffic control system” a policy objective and already securing $12.5 billion in funding, with wide aviation industry support.
But don’t forget, the FAA for more than two decades prior sought to update its technology under the NextGen programme, which obviously fell short.
Clearly, the problem is far bigger than any administration. So too may be the solution.

But another option exists: placing US ATC under a private or semi-private entity, as is done in many countries, Canada included. Such utility-like “air navigation service providers” are widely viewed as more effective and efficient, with revenue coming from user fees – not from Congress, on which the FAA depends. (Of course, recent meltdowns at the UK’s NATS are a reminder that not everything is perfect when the private sector is involved.)

ATC privatisation previously gained traction during the first Trump administration (with the support of airlines) but stalled amid opposition from some Democrats and industry groups like the National Business Aviation Association.
Don’t expect such pushback to have diminished.
In the end, the current Trump administration path might be the best option. Whether Washington agrees to stay the course is another matter.
In the meantime, the FAA’s outdated systems are not becoming any less outdated.
The post Will last week’s ATC failure help the FAA get more money to replace old technology – or less? first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 本周要求国会拨款 500 亿美元用于 ATC 现代化。
根据你问的是谁，美国 11 月 13 日的航空旅行崩溃要么反映了美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的管理不善，要么揭示了为什么国会应该额外拨款数十亿美元用于空中交通管制 (ATC) 现代化。
也许这两种说法都有道理。每个人都同意美国的空中交通管制系统已经无可救药地老旧，维护永远不应该导致全国范围内的地面停车。
事故发生时，FAA 承包商 L3Harris 正在用光缆替换铜线。该机构表示，还安装了一个新路由器。由此产生的技术故障（原因尚不清楚；调查正在进行中）导致 ATC 通信性能下降，促使 FAA 下令进行持续 4 小时的地面停留，并导致数千次航班取消。
交通部部长肖恩·达菲抓住了这个时机，将此次失败描述为国会应立即资助完成空中交通管制现代化的证据之一。达菲甚至提高了赌注，称他实际上需要 500 亿美元，而不是之前估计的 300 亿美元。
特朗普总统在《Truth Social》上补充道：“如果国会批准空中交通管制急需的资金，我们就可以快速有效地建设它。”
与此同时，一些民主党人指责达菲利用此次危机作为获得更多资金的“赎金”，同时质疑政府管理如此大规模项目的能力。纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔呼吁达菲辞职。
ATC 失败是美国人生活中的一个事实，比选举周期更常见，而且完全不分党派。 （美国联邦航空局之前于 2023 年在拜登政府领导下进行过全国范围内的地面停飞，原因是 NOTAM 系统中断。）
特朗普政府大力推动现代化建设，将“全新的空中交通管制系统”作为政策目标，并已获得 125 亿美元的资金，并得到航空业的广泛支持。
但不要忘记，二十多年来，美国联邦航空局一直在 NextGen 计划下寻求更新其技术，但显然未能实现这一目标。
显然，这个问题比任何一届政府都要严重得多。这也可能是解决方案。
但还存在另一种选择：将美国空中交通管制置于私营或半私营实体之下，就像包括加拿大在内的许多国家所做的那样。人们普遍认为，这种类似公用事业的“空中导航服务提供商”更加有效和高效，其收入来自用户费用，而不是美国联邦航空局所依赖的国会。 （当然，英国 NATS 最近的崩溃提醒我们，当私营部门参与时，并非一切都是完美的。）
空中交通管制私有化此前在特朗普第一届政府期间获得了关注（在航空公司的支持下），但由于一些民主党人和国家公务航空协会等行业团体的反对而陷入停滞。
不要指望这种阻力会减少。
最终，当前的特朗普政府路径可能是最好的选择。华盛顿是否同意坚持到底是另一回事。
与此同时，美国联邦航空局过时的系统并没有变得更过时。
上周的 ATC 故障是否会帮助 FAA 获得更多资金来更换旧技术——还是更少？首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

summary_zh: 剥离后，德事隆将持有德事隆航空、贝尔和德事隆系统公司。德事隆计划明年出售其工业部门，并成为
body_en: Divestiture will leave Textron holding Textron Aviation, Bell and Textron Systems.

Textron plans to sell off its industrial segment next year and become solely an aerospace and defence company, a move mirroring a broader trend which has seen several once-massive US conglomerates have broken up.
The manufacturer said on 18 November it has reached a deal to sell its industrials segment to private equity firm Kingswood Capital Management for $1.2 billion.
“Upon closing, New Textron will be a pure-play aerospace and defence company aligned to its core businesses of Textron Aviation, Bell and Textron Systems,” the company says.

Wichita-based Textron Aviation owns Beechcraft and Cessna, Texas-based Bell makes a range of civilian and military rotorcraft, and Providence-based Textron Systems produces electronic systems, piston aircraft engines (under the Lycoming brand), unmanned aircraft, marine craft and ground military vehicles.
The division to be sold includes Kautex, a battery and automotive fuel systems producer, and Textron Specialized Vehicles, which manufactures a range of small vehicles like golf and utility buggies.
“The sale… allows us to sharpen our strategic focus on growing our core A&D businesses while also returning capital to our shareholders,” Textron chief executive Lisa Atherton says.

Textron expects the deal, which remains subject to regulatory and other approvals, will close in the first half of next year. It estimates the aerospace and defence businesses will generate $12 billion in revenue this year.

Several US industrial powerhouses with defence and aerospace holdings have broken up in recent years, reflecting an increasingly popular management philosophy that pure-play firms are better positioned to respond to customers and market demands.

Honeywell spun Honeywell Aerospace into a standalone publicly traded firm this year, General Electric spun off non-aviation businesses to become GE Aerospace in 2024 , and United Technologies sold businesses and in 2020 merged its aerospace units into Raytheon to become RTX.

body_zh: 剥离后，德事隆将持有德事隆航空、贝尔和德事隆系统公司。
德事隆计划明年出售其工业部门，完全成为一家航空航天和国防公司，此举反映了一个更广泛的趋势，即几家曾经规模庞大的美国企业集团已经分拆。
该制造商于 11 月 18 日表示，已达成协议，以 12 亿美元的价格将其工业部门出售给私募股权公司 Kingswood Capital Management。
该公司表示：“交易完成后，新德事隆将成为一家纯粹的航空航天和国防公司，与其德事隆航空、贝尔和德事隆系统的核心业务保持一致。”
总部位于威奇托的德事隆航空拥有 Beechcraft 和 Cessna，总部位于德克萨斯州的贝尔生产一系列民用和军用旋翼机，总部位于普罗​​维登斯的德事隆系统公司生产电子系统、活塞飞机发动机（莱康明品牌）、无人机、船舶和地面军用车辆。
待出售的部门包括电池和汽车燃油系统生产商考泰斯 (Kautex) 以及生产高尔夫球和多功能越野车等一系列小型车辆的德事隆特种车辆公司 (Textron Specialized Vehicles)。
德事隆首席执行官丽莎·阿瑟顿 (Lisa Atherton) 表示：“此次出售……使我们能够更加专注于发展核心 A&D 业务，同时向股东返还资本。”
德事隆预计，该交易将于明年上半年完成，该交易仍有待监管部门和其他方面的批准。据估计，今年航空航天和国防业务将产生 120 亿美元的收入。
近年来，几家拥有国防和航空航天控股权的美国工业巨头纷纷分拆，反映出一种日益流行的管理理念，即纯粹的企业能够更好地响应客户和市场需求。
霍尼韦尔今年将霍尼韦尔航空航天公司拆分为一家独立的上市公司，通用电气于 2024 年剥离非航空业务，成为通用电气航空航天公司，联合技术公司出售业务，并于 2020 年将其航空航天部门合并到雷神公司，成为 RTX。
德事隆计划分拆后成为一家纯粹的航空航天和国防公司，该公司首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Google’s $10m purchase of Spirit data approved by court with union carve outs
title_zh: 谷歌以 1000 万美元收购 Spirit data 的交易获得法院批准，但工会除外
summary: Flight attendants’ and pilots’ unions dropped their objections after Spirit’s estate and Google agreed to exclude sensitive employee records from the data. A massive tranche of data from the former Spirit Airlines will be transferred to Google after a federal
summary_zh: 在 Spirit 资产管理公司和谷歌同意将敏感员工记录排除在外之后，空乘人员和飞行员工会放弃了反对意见。
body_en: Flight attendants’ and pilots’ unions dropped their objections after Spirit’s estate and Google agreed to exclude sensitive employee records from the data.
A massive tranche of data from the former Spirit Airlines will be transferred to Google after a federal judge approved the $10 million bankruptcy sale on 17 November.

The search giant first won the rights to the de-identified corporate data at auction in August with the intent to train artificial intelligence models. The deal prompted objections from flight attendants, pilots and lawmakers .
Through their unions, the former employees argued the terms of the deal did not include enough protections on personal data and worried it could be linked to them through advances in AI.

A court-appointed privacy ombudsman recommended the court approve the sale in October, noting that “the parties have taken consequential steps to protect the privacy of the personal data of the Spirit consumers”. Workers had argued that consumer data-privacy steps did not take into account that de-identification measures designed for consumers did not do enough for worker data.

Earlier in November, Spirit’s estate and Google agreed to further protections, and the unions dropped their objections. Payroll records, tax forms and crew base and pairing records are excluded from the sale entirely, and an independent agent must strip medical, disciplinary, biometric and other sensitive employee data before delivery.
If exclusions requested by the unions and Spirit’s suppliers shrink the total data by more than 8%, Google can walk away from the deal.

The data sale – which includes nearly two billion emails, 30 million lines of code, fuel slips, maintenance records and more – is one of the final assets of the former Spirit Airlines to be sold as part of the bankrupt carrier’s wind-down.
Other assets, including aircraft, real estate and other equipment, have already been sold. Twenty aircraft remain for sale and will be sold at a subsequent auction.

body_zh: 在 Spirit 资产管理公司和谷歌同意从数据中排除敏感员工记录后，空乘人员和飞行员工会放弃了反对意见。
11 月 17 日，联邦法官批准了价值 1000 万美元的破产出售案后，前精神航空 (Spirit Airlines) 的大量数据将被转移给谷歌。
这家搜索巨头首先在 8 月份的拍卖中赢得了去识别化的企业数据的使用权，目的是训练人工智能模型。这笔交易引起了空乘人员、飞行员和立法者的反对。
前雇员通过工会辩称，交易条款没有对个人数据提供足够的保护，并担心这些数据可能会通过人工智能的进步与他们联系起来。
法院指定的隐私监察员于 10 月份建议法院批准此次出售，并指出“双方已采取相应措施来保护烈酒消费者个人数据的隐私”。工人认为，​​消费者数据隐私措施没有考虑到为消费者设计的去识别化措施对工人数据的作用不够。
11 月初，Spirit 遗产管理公司和谷歌同意采取进一步保护措施，工会也放弃了反对意见。工资记录、纳税表、船员基础和配对记录完全不包括在销售范围内，独立代理人必须在交付前清除医疗、纪律、生物识别和其他敏感员工数据。
如果工会和 Spirit 供应商要求的排除使总数据减少超过 8%，谷歌可以放弃交易。
此次数据出售包括近 20 亿封电子邮件、3000 万行代码、燃油单、维护记录等，是前精神航空公司最终出售的资产之一，作为破产航空公司破产清算的一部分。
其他资产，包括飞机、房地产和其他设备，已经出售。仍有二十架飞机待售，并将在随后的拍卖中出售。
谷歌斥资 1000 万美元购买 Spirit 数据并获得法院批准并获得工会豁免的消息首先出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Schiebel proves ‘drone mothership’ operating concept during Camcopter S-100 trial
title_zh: Schiebel 在 Camcopter S-100 试验中证明了“无人机母舰”操作概念
summary: Uncrewed rotorcraft acts as launch platform and communications link for small UAS during proof-of-concept trial in Austria. Schiebel has demonstrated the ability of its Camcopter S-100 to act as a “drone mothership” during the deployment and operation of small
summary_zh: 在奥地利的概念验证试验期间，无人驾驶旋翼机充当小型无人机的发射平台和通信链路。席贝尔证明了
body_en: Uncrewed rotorcraft acts as launch platform and communications link for small UAS during proof-of-concept trial in Austria.
Schiebel has demonstrated the ability of its Camcopter S-100 to act as a “drone mothership” during the deployment and operation of small uncrewed aerial systems (UAS).

Announcing the advance on 18 November, the Austrian company says the vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) S-100 launched an OSIRIS Poland-produced HSCD-1 high-speed camera drone “whilst in forward flight”.

“Following release, the small drone was operated through a communications link relayed via the S-100, successfully demonstrating the concept of using the larger UAS as a drone mothership as well as an airborne control and video relay,” Schiebel says.

“While the demonstration was conducted with an inert variant, the concept can also support high-speed interceptor drones equipped with effectors or any other sUAS [small UAS] for a wide range of applications,” it adds.
That could include the carriage of counter-UAS systems and loitering munitions, “extending their operational reach and flexibility”, the company states.

“This proof-of-concept [activity] demonstrates the incredible potential of combining the mature and proven Camcopter with smaller, specialised unmanned systems,” says Schiebel Group chairman Hans Georg Schiebel.

“The successful integration of the OSIRIS HSCD-1 demonstrates a concept that can also be applied to high-speed interceptor drones, opening up new possibilities for diverse operational scenarios,” he adds.

body_zh: 在奥地利的概念验证试验期间，无人驾驶旋翼机充当小型无人机的发射平台和通信链路。
Schiebel 展示了其 Camcopter S-100 在小型无人航空系统 (UAS) 的部署和操作过程中充当“无人机母舰”的能力。
这家奥地利公司于 11 月 18 日宣布了这一进展，表示垂直起降 (VTOL) S-100“在向前飞行时”发射了 OSIRIS 波兰生产的 HSCD-1 高速摄像无人机。
“发布后，这架小型无人机通过 S-100 中继的通信链路进行操作，成功展示了使用大型无人机作为无人机母舰以及机载控制和视频中继的概念，”Schiebel 说。
“虽然演示是使用惰性变体进行的，但该概念还可以支持配备效应器的高速拦截无人机或任何其他 sUAS [小型无人机]，以实现广泛的应用，”它补充道。
该公司表示，这可能包括携带反无人机系统和徘徊弹药，“扩大其作战范围和灵活性”。
Schiebel 集团董事长 Hans Georg Schiebel 表示：“这项概念验证[活动]展示了将成熟且经过验证的 Camcopter 与小型专业无人系统相结合的巨大潜力。”
“OSIRIS HSCD-1 的成功集成展示了一个也可以应用于高速拦截无人机的概念，为不同的作战场景开辟了新的可能性，”他补充道。
Schiebel 在 Camcopter S-100 试验中证明“无人机母舰”操作概念的帖子首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: American Airlines’ Airbus A321neo Fleet Grows To 90, Expects 2 More & 1 A321XLR By Year’s End
title_zh: 美国航空的空客 A321neo 机队增至 90 架，预计年底前将增加 2 架和 1 架 A321XLR
summary: American Airlines' A321neo fleet reaches 90 aircraft, with three more A321-family deliveries expected before the end of 2026.
summary_zh: 美国航空的 A321neo 机队数量达到 90 架，预计在 2026 年底前将再交付三架 A321 系列飞机。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

American Airlines has expanded its Airbus A321neo fleet to 90 aircraft, with two more standard A321neos and one A321XLR expected before the end of 2026. The latest arrival continues the carrier's fleet modernization program , in which Airbus narrowbodies play an increasingly important role in its domestic and international networks.

The latest delivery follows an unusually busy period at the end of last month, when American received four A321-family aircraft in just seven days. Those deliveries included three standard A321neos and one A321XLR, registered N311NY. With no further Boeing deliveries expected this year, Airbus remains central to American's near-term fleet renewal strategy.
American's Airbus A321neo Fleet Reaches 90 Aircraft

American's standard A321neo fleet has reached 90 aircraft, with two more expected before the end of the year. The airline is also anticipating one additional A321XLR, extending its investment in long-range, single-aisle aircraft. If all three outstanding deliveries arrive as planned, American will finish 2026 with 92 standard A321neos, alongside its growing fleet of 12 A321XLRs.

American's third-quarter financial disclosures showed that it had 165 Airbus A320-family aircraft on order as of September 30, with seven scheduled for delivery during the final quarter. The subsequent acceleration in October, when four A321-family aircraft arrived within a week, highlighted the program's pace. American also expects another 27 A321-family deliveries in 2027, although the precise split between the standard A321neo and A321XLR has not been disclosed.
The A321XLR is particularly important to American's international expansion, allowing it to serve longer routes with fewer passengers than a widebody aircraft would typically accommodate.
Brian Znotins, American's former Senior Vice President of Network Planning, highlighted the aircraft's importance when announcing the carrier's 2027 international expansion .

"The A321XLR is transforming our international network, expanding it to offer destinations to satisfy every travel palate. Combined with our investments enhancing our onboard product and in-flight experience, travelers have more reasons to choose American when they fly around the world."
The A321XLR Is Transforming American's International Network

American received its first A321XLR in October 2025 , becoming the first US operator of the type. Its original 50-aircraft commitment was subsequently reduced to 40, including five delivered by the end of 2025. Each aircraft features 20 Flagship Suite business class seats, 12 premium economy seats, and 123 economy seats, emphasizing premium revenue over maximum capacity.

The XLR restores some of the long-range narrowbody capability American lost when it retired its 757s in 2020. Its economics make thinner transatlantic routes viable without deploying a much larger 787 Dreamliner. The aircraft initially entered service on premium transcontinental flights, before expanding into international markets as more aircraft became available.

American's 2027 schedule demonstrates its ambitions, with four additional European routes assigned to the XLR. Philadelphia-Vienna, measuring approximately 4,321 miles (6,955 km), is particularly notable as it will become the world's longest narrowbody flight . The route will operate daily from May 6 through January 2028, while New York gains new services to Amsterdam and Nice.
The A321neo Powers American's Domestic Expansion

The standard A321neo remains central to American's high-capacity narrowbody strategy. With its fleet now at 90 aircraft, it still has firm orders for 126 more airframes as the airline continues investing in the type to support busy domestic routes and replace older aircraft.

Configured with 196 seats, including 20 First Class and 47 Main Cabin Extra seats, American's legacy A321neos accommodate 41 more passengers than the XLR. It is particularly valuable on busy domestic routes connecting American's major hubs and supports the gradual replacement of older narrowbodies. Its versatility extends internationally, with Philadelphia-Reykjavík scheduled to launch in May 2027 .

American's Boeing 737 MAX 8s complement the A321neos, offering 172 seats on routes requiring less capacity. The airline also has substantial outstanding Boeing narrowbody orders, including the larger 737 MAX 10, although deliveries of that variant are not expected until 2029 or later. With an eventual planned fleet size of more than 250 A321-family aircraft, Airbus narrowbodies will continue to play a leading role in American's domestic modernization and expanding transatlantic network.

body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
美国航空已将其空客 A321neo 机队扩大至 90 架飞机，预计在 2026 年底前再增加两架标准 A321neo 和一架 A321XLR。最新抵达的飞机继续了该航空公司的机队现代化计划，其中空客窄体机在其国内和国际网络中发挥着越来越重要的作用。
最近一次交付是在上月底异常繁忙的时期之后进行的，当时美国航空在短短 7 天内收到了四架 A321 系列飞机。这些交付包括三架标准 A321neo 和一架注册为 N311NY 的 A321XLR。由于预计今年波音不会再交付飞机，空客仍然是美国航空近期机队更新战略的核心。
美国航空空客 A321neo 机队数量达到 90 架
美国航空的标准 A321neo 机队已达到 90 架飞机，预计年底前还会增加两架。该航空公司还预计将再添一架 A321XLR，以扩大其对远程单通道飞机的投资。如果所有三架未交付的飞机均按计划抵达，美国航空将在 2026 年拥有 92 架标准 A321neo，以及不断壮大的 12 架 A321XLR 机队。
美国航空第三季度财务披露显示，截至 9 月 30 日，该公司已订购 165 架空客 A320 系列飞机，其中 7 架计划在最后季度交付。随后的 10 月份加速，四架 A321 系列飞机在一周内抵达，突显了该计划的进度。美国航空还预计在 2027 年再交付 27 架 A321 系列，但标准 A321neo 和 A321XLR 之间的精确分配尚未披露。
A321XLR 对于美国航空的国际扩张尤为重要，与宽体飞机相比，它能够以更少的乘客提供更长的航线。
美国航空公司前网络规划高级副总裁布赖恩·兹诺廷斯 (Brian Znotins) 在宣布该航空公司 2027 年国际扩张计划时强调了该飞机的重要性。
“A321XLR 正在改变我们的国际网络，将其扩展为提供满足各种旅行口味的目的地。结合我们对增强机上产品和飞行体验的投资，旅客在环游世界时有更多理由选择美国航空。”
A321XLR 正在改变美国航空的国际网络
美国航空于 2025 年 10 月接收了第一架 A321XLR，成为美国第一家该类型运营商。其最初的 50 架飞机承诺随后减少到 40 架，其中 5 架将于 2025 年底交付。每架飞机均设有 20 个旗舰套房商务舱座位、12 个豪华经济舱座位和 123 个经济舱座位，强调溢价收入超过最大运力。
XLR 恢复了美国航空在 2020 年退役 757 时失去的部分远程窄体机能力。其经济性使更细的跨大西洋航线变得可行，而无需部署更大的 787 梦想飞机。该飞机最初在高级跨大陆航班上投入使用，随后随着更多飞机的出现而扩展到国际市场。
美国航空 2027 年的时间表展示了其雄心，新增 4 条欧洲航线分配给 XLR。费城-维也纳航线全长约 4,321 英里（6,955 公里），尤其引人注目，因为它将成为世界上最长的窄体飞机。该航线将于 5 月 6 日至 2028 年 1 月期间每天运营，同时纽约将新增飞往阿姆斯特丹和尼斯的航班。
A321neo 为美国航空的国内扩张提供动力
标准 A321neo 仍然是美国航空大容量窄体机战略的核心。其机队目前拥有 90 架飞机，但由于该航空公司继续投资该型号飞机以支持繁忙的国内航线并更换旧飞机，因此仍有 126 架飞机的确定订单。
美国航空的传统 A321neos 配备 196 个座位，其中包括 20 个头等舱座位和 47 个主舱额外座位，比 XLR 多容纳 41 名乘客。它在连接美国主要枢纽的繁忙国内航线上尤其有价值，并支持逐步更换旧的窄体飞机。其多功能性已扩展到国际范围，计划于 2027 年 5 月开通费城-雷克雅未克航线。
美国航空的波音 737 MAX 8 是对 A321neo 的补充，在运力需求较少的航线上提供 172 个座位。该航空公司还拥有大量未完成的波音窄体飞机订单，包括较大的 737 MAX 10，不过该型号飞机预计要到 2029 年或更晚才会交付。最终规划的机队规模将超过 250 架 A321 系列飞机，空中客车窄体飞机将继续在美国国内现代化和不断扩大的跨大西洋网络中发挥主导作用。

body_en: TAP to launch year-round Porto–Washington flights in March 2027 - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Porto Airport (OPO) TAP to launch year-round Porto–Washington flights in March 2027

TAP Air Portugal will launch a non-stop service between Porto and Washington Dulles on 30 March 2027, operating three times weekly throughout the year. Washington will become the airline’s third US destination and eighth intercontinental destination from Porto.

The route will use Airbus A321LR aircraft with 171 seats , including 16 in business class. During the summer timetable, flights will depart Porto on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays, with departures from Washington on Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays. Scheduled flight times are eight hours and 35 minutes westbound and seven hours and 25 minutes eastbound.

Washington will join New York and Boston in TAP’s US network from Porto, complementing the airline’s existing Lisbon–Washington service. TAP chief executive Luís Rodrigues said the addition would strengthen northern Portugal’s international connectivity and support business and tourism.

The expansion follows TAP’s 2026 launches from Porto to Terceira, Praia and Sal, alongside the extension of Boston flights to year-round operation. The airline is also developing a maintenance and engineering hub at Porto Airport, scheduled for completion in 2028 and expected to create around 200 specialised jobs.

Home Manufacturers Antonov Russian An-12 reportedly crashes in Siberia, killing 19

A Russian military transport aircraft, reported to be an Antonov An-12, crashed near Yagunovo in the Kemerovo region of southwestern Siberia on 17 November 2026, killing all 19 people on board, according to Russian media reports.

Regional governor Ilya Seredyuk confirmed that an aircraft had crashed at around 21:30 local time, but did not identify its type. The aircraft was reportedly flying from Novosibirsk to Kansk in Krasnoyarsk Krai.

Medical teams, police, emergency services and National Guard personnel were deployed to the site. Russian state-controlled broadcaster Ren TV reported that the crew tried to steer the burning aircraft away from residential buildings. That account has yet to be independently verified.
The cause of the crash has not been disclosed. The An-12 is a Soviet-designed, four-engine turboprop transport developed in the 1950s for carrying troops, equipment and cargo.

医疗队、警察、紧急服务人员和国民警卫队人员被部署到现场。俄罗斯国家控制的广播公司仁电视台报道称，机组人员试图将燃烧的飞机驾驶远离住宅楼。该账户尚未得到独立核实。
