title_en: Avelo Airlines Launches 16 New Routes In 4 Weeks: See Full List Now
title_zh: Avelo Airlines 在 4 周内开通 16 条新航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: They include three airports brand-new to the carrier's map. Find out more here!
summary_zh: 其中包括该航空公司地图上全新的三个机场。在这里了解更多！
body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

Newish airlines tend to grow strongly, benefiting from the revenue, unit cost, market share, and competitive advantages of doing so. For example, five-year-old Breeze Airways ' passenger traffic grew by 47% in the 12 months to August. In distinct contrast, Avelo Airlines ' passenger numbers fell by 15%.

Avelo has been struggling recently as it seeks to find what works. As such, it has cut many routes, including its entire international operation , and removed multiple served airports from its map. However, the airline, whose fleet consists of 17 Boeing 737-700s and 737-800s, will launch 16 new routes in November and December. Still, compared to the same two months in 2025, 30+ routes have been removed.

Analysis of the airline's schedule submission to Cirium Diio has been explored. This compared the budget operator's network between January 2025 and October 2026 with what is set to operate in November 2026. The process found that the following ten routes will launch. This includes a return to the Caribbean . However, as the two routes will be to Aguadilla , Puerto Rico, they'll be domestic. Aguadilla is a brand-new destination for Avelo.

Half of the entries will be from McKinney (DTX), where Avelo's latest base just opened. Located around 34 miles (54 km) north of downtown Dallas, McKinney's passenger terminal opened on November 11 . Not surprisingly, that was exactly when the ultra-low-cost carrier Avelo began flying from the airport. In doing so, the carrier now serves three airports in the Lone Star State: Dallas/Fort Worth, McKinney, and Houston Intercontinental.
McKinney is near Dallas, Concord is near Charlotte, and Lakeland is between Orlando and Tampa

Initially, Avelo had one aircraft based at McKinney. However, that'll jump to two this month and, eventually, three. When a trio of aircraft are stationed there, nearly a third of the budget carrier's fleet will be there, which perhaps illustrates the challenges that it has faced.

Simple Flying's Live Flight Tracker shows that the N801XT and N803XT, both of which are 737-800s, will be there this week, although the specific airframes may change in the future. Generally, each aircraft has four legs per day. For example, on November 19, the 20.8-year-old N803XT, which is ex-Turkish Airlines, will fly McKinney-Orlando-McKinney-Las Vegas-McKinney.
They'll Be Followed by Six Routes In December

They will all be from McKinney and, like the five mentioned earlier, will be brand-new markets. Significantly, it'll be the first time that Avelo has flown to Denver, albeit only with one route and four weekly departures. It'll mark Avelo's return to Colorado after last flying there in September 2024 from Burbank to Colorado Springs.

Previously, the airline also flew from Burbank to Grand Junction and from Burbank and Las Vegas to Fort Collins. The new route contributes to Avelo having a record number of flights to Atlanta, the world's busiest airport for passengers but not for flights

However, context is needed. Only three markets will exist: Lakeland, McKinney, and Tweed New Haven. Previously, Avelo flew there from Wilmington, Delaware. Things are not this simple, as it appears that Lakeland-Atlanta service will end in early January 2027. No flights are scheduled beyond there, but that might change.

US Department of Transportation (DOT) information currently extends to August 2026. In the 12 months to that summer month, Avelo transported nearly 2.3 million round-trip passengers. Compared to the prior 12 months, traffic fell by 15%. While not a like-for-like comparison, Breeze grew by 47%.

Avelo's average load factor is 77.7%. While that is low compared to many budget operators around the world, it is relatively normal for US airlines. As the number of seats for sale fell by 16%, the smaller reduction in traffic (-15%) means that the load factor improved to the highest level since the 12 months to August 2023. What is not known is how fares changed.
body_zh: 詹姆斯与路线开发息息相关。詹姆斯曾就读于拉夫堡大学和克兰菲尔德大学航空运输管理专业，拥有航空公司战略和经济学博士学位。 James 曾任伦敦卢顿机场市场机会分析师和 anna.aero 首席分析师。他向本科生和研究生教授航空公司战略和经济学五年，并与多家航空公司在航线和市场情报项目上密切合作。他居住在英国伦敦附近。
新成立的航空公司往往会强劲增长，受益于收入、单位成本、市场份额和竞争优势。例如，成立五年的微风航空 (Breeze Airways) 在截至 8 月的 12 个月内客运量增长了 47%。与此形成鲜明对比的是，Avelo Airlines 的乘客人数下降了 15%。
Avelo 最近一直在努力寻找有效的方法。因此，它削减了许多航线，包括其整个国际运营，并从其地图上删除了多个服务机场。然而，该航空公司的机队由 17 架波音 737-700 和 737-800 组成，将于 11 月和 12 月开通 16 条新航线。尽管如此，与 2025 年的两个月相比，仍有 30 多条航线被取消。
对航空公司向 Cirium Diio 提交的时刻表进行了分析。该报告将这家廉价运营商在 2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 10 月期间的网络与计划于 2026 年 11 月运营的网络进行了比较。该过程发现，将开通以下 10 条航线。这包括返回加勒比海。然而，由于这两条航线将飞往波多黎各的阿瓜迪亚，因此它们将是国内航线。阿瓜迪亚是阿维洛的一个全新目的地。
一半的参赛作品将来自麦金尼 (DTX)，Avelo 的最新基地刚刚在那里开业。麦金尼客运大楼位于达拉斯市中心以北约 34 英里（54 公里）处，于 11 月 11 日启用。毫不奇怪，这正是超低成本航空公司阿维洛 (Avelo) 开始从机场起飞的时间。通过这样做，该航空公司现在为孤星州的三个机场提供服务：达拉斯/沃斯堡、麦金尼和休斯顿洲际机场。
麦金尼靠近达拉斯，康科德靠近夏洛特，莱克兰位于奥兰多和坦帕之间
最初，阿维洛在麦金尼拥有一架飞机。然而，这个月这个数字将跃升至两个，最终达到三个。当三架飞机驻扎在那里时，这家廉价航空公司机队的近三分之一将在那里，这也许说明了它所面临的挑战。
Simple Flying 的实时飞行跟踪显示，N801XT 和 N803XT（均为 737-800）将于本周上市，尽管具体机身将来可能会发生变化。一般来说，每架飞机每天有四个航段。例如，11月19日，前土耳其航空公司机龄20.8年的N803XT将执飞麦金尼-奥兰多-麦金尼-拉斯维加斯-麦金尼。
12 月将有六条路线紧随其后
它们都将来自麦金尼，并且像前面提到的五个一样，将是全新的市场。值得注意的是，这将是阿维洛首次飞往丹佛，尽管只有一条航线，每周有四趟航班。这将标志着 Avelo 继 2024 年 9 月最后一次从伯班克飞往科罗拉多斯普林斯之后返回科罗拉多州。
此前，该航空公司还开通了从伯班克飞往大章克申以及从伯班克和拉斯维加斯飞往柯林斯堡的航班。新航线使阿维洛飞往亚特兰大的航班数量创历史新高，亚特兰大是世界上旅客最繁忙的机场，但航班却不是最繁忙的机场
然而，需要上下文。仅存在三个市场：莱克兰、麦金尼和特威德纽黑文。此前，阿维洛从特拉华州威尔明顿飞往那里。事情没那么简单，莱克兰-亚特兰大航班似乎将于 2027 年 1 月上旬结束。除此之外没有航班安排，但这可能会改变。
美国交通部 (DOT) 的信息目前延续至 2026 年 8 月。在截至夏季月份的 12 个月内，Avelo 运送了近 230 万名往返乘客。与前 12 个月相比，流量下降了 15%。虽然不是同类比较，但 Breeze 增长了 47%。
Avelo 的平均负载率为 77.7%。虽然与世界各地的许多廉价航空公司相比，这一比例较低，但对于美国航空公司来说，这相对正常。由于待售座位数下降了 16%，客流量减少幅度较小（-15%），这意味着客座率改善至 2023 年 8 月之前 12 个月以来的最高水平。目前尚不清楚的是票价如何变化。

title_en: 3,400+ Miles: Air Canada's Longest Ever Boeing 737 MAX Flights Launch In 4 Weeks
title_zh: 3,400 多英里：加拿大航空有史以来最长的波音 737 MAX 航班在 4 周内启动
summary: Air Canada is preparing its longest Boeing 737 MAX route as Rouge undergoes a major fleet and capacity expansion.
summary_zh: 随着 Rouge 进行大型机队和运力扩张，加拿大航空正在准备其最长的波音 737 MAX 航线。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

Air Canada is preparing to launch its longest-ever Boeing 737 MAX 8 route in less than four weeks. Beginning December 13, the Canadian flag carrier will connect Vancouver International Airport (YVR) with Liberia International Airport (LIR) in Costa Rica, covering 3,425 miles (5,512 km). The new service will surpass Montreal-Nantes as the airline's longest MAX route by distance, while the return journey will have a scheduled block time of up to eight hours and 55 minutes.

The route will be operated by Air Canada Rouge, the airline's leisure subsidiary, which is undergoing a significant transformation. Air Canada is transferring its 737 MAX fleet to Rouge , while moving older Airbus narrowbodies to mainline operations or retiring them. The result will be a substantially larger Rouge fleet, with nearly 70% more installed seats than at the end of 2025.

Air Canada's new Vancouver-Liberia service will launch on December 13, operating twice-weekly until April 12, 2027, with three weekly departures during selected periods. Flights will use Rouge's 177-seat 737 MAX 8 , configured with 12 business-class, 18 preferred economy and 147 standard economy seats. The route is part of Air Canada's expanded winter sun network .

The route will provide another nonstop option for Canadians visiting Costa Rica's Guanacaste region, known for its Pacific beaches and resorts. Air Canada will compete directly with WestJet, which already operates Vancouver-Liberia flights using the MAX 8. The additional service also strengthens Vancouver's position as a departure point for winter leisure travel to Central America.

The new route follows the opening of Rouge's Vancouver crew base in March this year, supporting the airline's Western Canada expansion amidst the ongoing fleet transformation. The updated Rouge cabin includes seatback entertainment, reclining seats, and complimentary Wi-Fi for Aeroplan members, making it better suited for longer leisure flights.
Air Canada's COO Mark Nasr emphasized the importance of a consistent passenger experience across the airline's network.

“When customers step onto our aircraft, they should instantly feel a sense of comfort, care, and pride. This renewal program is about delivering that feeling consistently, across every flight. Every update is designed with our customers in mind, as we introduce an entirely new Air Canada Rouge product.”
The 10 Longest 737 MAX Routes In Air Canada's History

Air Canada's 737 MAX 8 has operated some remarkably long routes, including transatlantic flights to Ireland, France, Belgium, and the United Kingdom, as well as services to Hawaii and the Caribbean. However, the new Vancouver-Liberia route will take the top spot at 3,425 miles (5,512 km), exceeding Montreal-Nantes by 98 miles (158 km).
MAX in summer 2018; returns June 2027 with A321XLR
MAX in winter 2023/24; no current MAX service confirmed
MAX in summer 2026; mixed A321XLR/MAX deployment

The ranking illustrates how Air Canada has used the MAX to support thinner transatlantic markets. Halifax to London Heathrow Airport (LHR) is particularly significant, recording nearly 2,000 departures since the variant was introduced, while Montreal–Nantes and Toronto–Shannon demonstrate the aircraft's ability to serve secondary European destinations. Several of these routes are now transitioning to the longer-range Airbus A321XLR .

Beyond Europe, the MAX has also supported long leisure routes from Western Canada , including Calgary-Honolulu and Calgary-Kahului. But the aircraft's future is increasingly tied to Rouge's leisure strategy, with Edmonton-Montego Bay joining Vancouver-Liberia in December 2026. These additions illustrate how Air Canada is redirecting its MAX fleet toward vacation destinations while deploying the A321XLR on selected longer international routes.
Air Canada Rouge's Fleet Expansion Will Increase Its Seat Count By 70%

Rouge's transformation involves more than replacing aging Airbus aircraft. At the end of 2025, the subsidiary operated 33 aircraft, comprising 15 A319s, five A320s and 13 A321s. Air Canada's fleet plans envisage an eventual all-MAX fleet of 52 aircraft, representing a 58% increase. The A320s and A321s are being transferred to mainline following refurbishment, while the A319s are being retired.

The capacity implications are substantial. Rouge's fleet will grow from 33 to 52 aircraft, but with the average aircraft capacity also increasing from 164 to 177 seats, the installed fleet seats will increase from 5,428 to 9,204, a gain of 3,776 seats, or 70%. Standardizing around the MAX should simplify training, maintenance and scheduling while providing newer aircraft with improved fuel efficiency.

The larger fleet also gives Air Canada more flexibility to expand leisure flying from Western Canada , supported by Rouge's new Vancouver base. New services to Liberia, Mazatlán and Puerto Escondido illustrate that strategy, while mainline receives refurbished Airbus aircraft and introduces the A321XLR for longer international operations. Vancouver-Liberia is therefore more than a distance record: it represents the emerging role of a substantially larger Rouge operation within Air Canada's network.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
加拿大航空正准备在不到四个星期的时间内开通其有史以来最长的波音 737 MAX 8 航线。从 12 月 13 日开始，这家加拿大国旗航空公司将连接温哥华国际机场 (YVR) 和哥斯达黎加的利比里亚国际机场 (LIR)，航程 3,425 英里（5,512 公里）。新航线将超越蒙特利尔-南特，成为该航空公司距离最长的 MAX 航线，而回程航班的预定阻塞时间将长达 8 小时 55 分钟。
该航线将由该航空公司的休闲子公司加航 Rouge 运营，该公司正在经历重大转型。加拿大航空正在将其 737 MAX 机队转移到 Rouge，同时将旧的空客窄体飞机转移到干线运营或退役。其结果将是 Rouge 机队规模大幅扩大，安装座位数比 2025 年底增加近 70%。
加拿大航空全新的温哥华-利比里亚航线将于 12 月 13 日开通，每周运营两班，直至 2027 年 4 月 12 日，在特定时段每周运营三班。航班将使用 Rouge 拥有 177 个座位的 737 MAX 8 飞机，配置有 12 个商务舱座位、18 个首选经济舱座位和 147 个标准经济舱座位。该航线是加拿大航空扩大的冬季阳光航线网络的一部分。
该航线将为访问哥斯达黎加瓜纳卡斯特地区的加拿大人提供另一个直达选择，该地区以其太平洋海滩和度假村而闻名。加拿大航空将与西捷航空直接竞争，西捷航空已经使用 MAX 8 运营温哥华至利比里亚的航班。这项附加服务还加强了温哥华作为前往中美洲的冬季休闲旅行出发点的地位。
这条新航线是在今年 3 月 Rouge 的温哥华机组人员基地开业后开通的，以支持该航空公司在正在进行的机队转型中向加拿大西部扩张。更新后的 Rouge 客舱包括椅背娱乐系统、斜倚座椅以及 Aeroplan 会员的免费 Wi-Fi，使其更适合长途休闲飞行。
加拿大航空首席运营官马克·纳斯尔强调了整个航空公司网络一致的乘客体验的重要性。
“当乘客踏上我们的飞机时，他们应该立即感受到舒适、关怀和自豪感。这项更新计划旨在在每次飞行中始终如一地传递这种感觉。随着我们推出全新的加航 Rouge 产品，每次更新都是以客户为中心而设计的。”
加拿大航空历史上 737 MAX 最长的 10 条航线
加拿大航空的 737 MAX 8 运营过一些非常长的航线，包括飞往爱尔兰、法国、比利时和英国的跨大西洋航班，以及飞往夏威夷和加勒比地区的航班。然而，温哥华-利比里亚的新航线将以 3,425 英里（5,512 公里）的里程位居榜首，比蒙特利尔-南特 98 英里（158 公里）高。
2018年夏季MAX；携 A321XLR 于 2027 年 6 月回归
2023/24 冬季 MAX；当前未确认 MAX 服务
2026 年夏季 MAX； A321XLR/MAX 混合部署
该排名说明了加拿大航空如何利用 MAX 来支持规模较小的跨大西洋市场。哈利法克斯飞往伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 的航班尤其重要，自该型号推出以来已记录近 2,000 架次出发航班，而蒙特利尔-南特和多伦多-香农则展示了该飞机为欧洲次要目的地提供服务的能力。其中几条航线现在正在过渡到航程更长的空客 A321XLR。
除欧洲之外，MAX 还支持从加拿大西部出发的长途休闲航线，包括卡尔加里-檀香山和卡尔加里-卡胡鲁伊。但该飞机的未来与 Rouge 的休闲战略越来越紧密地联系在一起，埃德蒙顿-蒙特哥湾航线将于 2026 年 12 月加入温哥华-利比里亚航线。这些新增航线表明加拿大航空如何将其 MAX 机队转向度假目的地，同时在选定的较长国际航线上部署 A321XLR。
加拿大航空 Rouge 机队扩张将使座位数增加 70%
Rouge 的转型不仅仅涉及更换老化的空客飞机。截至2025年底，该子公司运营飞机33架，其中A31915架、A3205架、A32113架。加拿大航空的机队计划预计最终将拥有 52 架全 MAX 飞机，增加 58%。 A320 和 A321 经翻新后将转入干线，而 A319 则将退役。
容量影响是巨大的。 Rouge的机队数量将从33架增加到52架，平均飞机容量也从164个座位增加到177个座位，机队安装座位数将从5,428个增加到9,204个，增加3,776个座位，即增加70%。围绕 MAX 进行标准化应该可以简化培训、维护和调度，同时为新型飞机提供更高的燃油效率。
更大的机队还使加拿大航空在 Rouge 新温哥华基地的支持下，能够更加灵活地拓展从加拿大西部出发的休闲航班。飞往利比里亚、马萨特兰和埃斯孔迪多港的新航班体现了这一战略，而干线则接收翻新的空客飞机，并引入 A321XLR 进行长期国际运营。因此，温哥华-利比里亚不仅仅是一个距离记录：它代表了加拿大航空网络中规模更大的 Rouge 运营的新兴角色。

title_en: Why The World's Debut Boeing 747 Was Built In Half The Time Of Other Aircraft Of Its Size In 1968
title_zh: 为什么 1968 年世界首秀的波音 747 的制造时间是其他同尺寸飞机的一半
summary: Just 29 months separated the Boeing 747 project’s official launch and the rollout of the first model.
summary_zh: 波音747项目正式启动与首架机型推出仅相隔29个月。
body_en: Based in the UK, Josh is a keen writer with a degree in Military History. Having worked previously as a financial journalist, he has covered the aviation industry extensively, reporting on airlines' results and monthly passenger statistics in the aftermath of the pandemic, alongside the likes of regulation around sustainable fuels, and the prospects for hydrogen-powered commercial flight. He joins Simple Flying with a lifelong love of all things aviation.

The Boeing 747 has earned its title as one of the most iconic airliners ever built for several reasons. It was the first widebody aircraft, easily distinguishable by a humped second deck, a key enabler in opening up aviation to the masses, and it enjoyed roughly fifty years of production. But equally as impressive as the Queen of the Skies itself is how it came about.

Boeing took the 747 from the drawing board to rollout remarkably quickly. That is, notably faster than the Airbus A380 program took to churn out its first model after officially launching, and quicker than both Boeing and Airbus took with their latest widebodies. What is more, Boeing pulled it off decades ago in the late 1960s.

Just 29 months separated the 747 project’s official launch and the rollout of the first model. Boeing announced on April 13, 1966, that it would build the 490-seat passenger transport that would come to be known as the 747. Exactly two years, five months, and 17 days later, on September 30, 1968, the first 747-100 ceremoniously rolled off the production line at a new purpose-built assembly plant in Everett, Washington.

Less than five months later, on February 9, 1969, the aircraft took off for its maiden flight . Test pilots Jack Waddell and Brien Wygle, accompanied by flight engineer Jess Wallick, took the controls, and the jumbo jet passed the major test with flying colors, paving the way for its introduction into service just under a year later in January 1970.

All told, that saw the Queen of the Skies go from a mere concept to carrying passengers in under four years. While that is no doubt a rapid turnaround by today’s standards, the reasons behind the pace are plentiful and clear-cut.

Behind it all was keen interest from Pan American World Airways , which had set out to source a jet two and a half times larger than the existing Boeing 707 against the backdrop of an increasingly busy market. Though the industry was mulling whether supersonic flight would come to dominate in the years ahead, there remained appeal for a huge, versatile airliner that could handle cargo operations rather than passenger services in the future, if needed.

As it turned out, Boeing had already looked into something similar, having lost out in a 1965 military transport design competition to the Lockheed C-5 Galaxy . Although the 747 was ultimately largely built from scratch, research into high-bypass engine technology and the thinking behind the 747’s distinctive hump can be traced back to the military project bid. As such, when Pan Am head Juan Trippe and then-Boeing president William Allen met that same year for initial discussions about the 747, something of a basis was already there.

It was Trippe himself who is said to have pushed so heavily for the 747. He had spent years beforehand attempting to open up aviation to the masses, overseeing the introduction of the world’s first economy fare in 1958, for instance. Given that an ambitious project like the 747 would only aid in reaching that goal, Trippe reportedly told Allen in 1965: “ If you’ll build it, I’ll buy it. ” By April 1966, the commitment was solidified through a $525 million deal — worth almost $5.5 billion today — for 25 of the new jumbo jets. This set an ambitious deadline of 1969 for the first delivery, though.
The Incredibles And The Huge Workforce Behind The 747 Project

Nonetheless, Boeing did not waste any time in dwelling on the task at hand. After signing the contract with Pan Am, the design team of just a few hundred workers conceptualizing and writing up requirements for the 747 ballooned to 4,500 almost instantaneously. These workers, who would later become part of a group known as The Incredibles, were led by Joe Sutter, who would similarly earn the title of the Father of the 747 over time.

Sutter himself enjoyed a 40-year-long career at Boeing, although he recalled in a 2013 interview fearing for his job as he and his team rushed to get the 747 ready. Without public backing, Boeing found itself racking up debt on the back of the project, leaving Sutter under pressure to cut jobs. Instead, he requested hundreds more engineers. “ I figured that was the day I lost my job at Boeing, ” he said, “ but I went to work the next day, and nobody said anything, so I kept working."

According to Boeing, some 50,000 employees ultimately ended up working on the jumbo jet over the course of its development cycle. Armed with an eye-watering 75,000 drawings, physical assembly of the first model got underway in September 1967, a year prior to its initial presentation to the world and only 16 months before the first flight. All of this, of course, required a specialized facility for production to actually be carried out.

Such a factory did not exist when Boeing first unveiled plans for the 747, so it had to be built almost in conjunction with the first model. Among the battles Sutter fought in his bid to steer the project to a timely conclusion was one over where his team would be based. Faced with the proposal of being sent to California, Sutter argued against it and insisted his engineers stay close to where those who would eventually build the aircraft would work.

This turned out to be Everett, which was far from Boeing’s first choice to house the 747 program initially, but prevailed on similar fears that key personnel would not relocate in great numbers to a new facility elsewhere. Regardless of where the 747 would be built, a new building would have to be constructed to accommodate such a vast aircraft and all the equipment needed to build it.

Under the tight deadline set by the deal with Pan Am, Boeing set about clearing forest and then building the facility in 1967. Work began just before assembly of the first 747 started, but the two efforts overlapped, meaning the prototype was under construction in an incomplete factory for a period. When the former was eventually completed, it took the crown as the largest building in the world by volume — a title it retains to this day and a reflection of the mammoth undertaking by Boeing to get the project off the ground.

Naturally, such an effort required vast financial backing, and it took a monumental amount of risk on Boeing’s part to get the first 747 successfully turned around at such a pace. Boeing had secured $525 million — or $21 million per aircraft — under its deal with Pan Am. This covered barely half of the program's total $1 billion cost as it transpired; however, adjusted for inflation, it would exceed $10 billion today.
body_zh: 乔什居住在英国，是一位热心作家，拥有军事史学位。此前，他曾担任财经记者，广泛报道了航空业，报道了疫情后航空公司的业绩和每月乘客统计数据，以及可持续燃料的监管以及氢动力商业航班的前景等。他带着对航空一切事物的终生热爱加入了 Simple Flying。
波音 747 因其多种原因而赢得了有史以来最具标志性的客机之一的称号。它是第一架宽体飞机，通过隆起的第二层甲板很容易区分，是向大众开放航空业的关键推动者，它已经生产了大约五十年。但与天空女王本身同样令人印象深刻的是它的诞生过程。
波音公司以 747 从设计阶段到推出的速度非常快。也就是说，这明显快于空中客车 A380 项目正式启动后生产其首款机型的速度，也比波音和空客推出最新宽体客机的速度快。更重要的是，波音公司在 20 世纪 60 年代末几十年前就实现了这一目标。
747项目的正式启动和第一架飞机的推出仅相隔29个月。波音公司于 1966 年 4 月 13 日宣布，将建造 490 座的客运运输机，后来被称为 747。整整两年零五个月零 17 天后，即 1968 年 9 月 30 日，第一架 747-100 在华盛顿州埃弗里特的一家新的专门组装工厂隆重下线。
不到五个月后，即 1969 年 2 月 9 日，该飞机首次起飞。试飞员 Jack Waddell 和 Brien Wygle 在飞行工程师 Jess Wallick 的陪同下接管了控制装置，这架大型喷气式飞机出色地通过了主要测试，为不到一年后的 1970 年 1 月投入使用铺平了道路。
总而言之，天空女王在不到四年的时间里从一个单纯的概念变成了载客。虽然以今天的标准来看，这无疑是一个快速的转变，但这种速度背后的原因是充分而明确的。
这一切的背后是泛美世界航空公司的浓厚兴趣，在市场日益繁忙的背景下，该公司已着手采购一架比现有波音 707 大两倍半的喷气式飞机。尽管业界正在考虑超音速飞行是否会在未来几年占据主导地位，但如果需要的话，人们仍然对大型多功能客机的需求仍然存在，这种客机可以在未来处理货运业务而不是客运服务。

事实证明，波音公司已经在研究类似的东西，并在 1965 年的军事运输设计竞赛中输给了洛克希德 C-5 Galaxy。尽管 747 最终很大程度上是从头开始制造的，但对高涵道比发动机技术的研究以及 747 独特驼峰背后的思考可以追溯到军事项目投标。因此，当泛美航空总裁胡安·特里普 (Juan Trippe) 和当时的波音公司总裁威廉·艾伦 (William Allen) 同年会面并就 747 进行初步讨论时，已经有了一些基础。

据说，特里普本人大力推动 747 的发展。他早在几年前就花了数年时间试图向大众开放航空业，例如在 1958 年监督推出了世界上第一个经济舱票价。鉴于像 747 这样雄心勃勃的项目只会有助于实现这一目标，据报道，特里普在 1965 年告诉艾伦：“如果你愿意建造它，我就买它。”到 1966 年 4 月，这一承诺通过一项价值 5.25 亿美元的交易得到了巩固——如今价值近 55 亿美元——购买 25 架新型大型喷气式飞机。不过，这为首次交付设定了一个雄心勃勃的截止日期：1969 年。
747 项目背后的不可思议和庞大的劳动力
尽管如此，波音公司并没有浪费任何时间来思考手头的任务。与泛美航空签订合同后，负责构思和编写 747 飞机需求的数百名员工的设计团队几乎瞬间激增至 4,500 人。这些工人后来成为“超人总动员”组织的一部分，由乔·萨特 (Joe Sutter) 领导，随着时间的推移，他同样赢得了 747 之父的称号。
萨特本人在波音公司度过了 40 年的职业生涯，尽管他在 2013 年的一次采访中回忆说，当他和他的团队匆忙准备 747 时，他担心自己的工作会受到影响。由于没有公众的支持，波音公司发现自己在该项目上负债累累，萨特面临着裁员的压力。相反，他又要求了数百名工程师。 “我以为那一天我失去了波音的工作，”他说，“但第二天我去上班，没有人说什么，所以我继续工作。”
据波音公司称，在这架大型喷气式飞机的开发周期中，最终约有 50,000 名员工参与其中。凭借令人瞠目结舌的 75,000 张图纸，第一个模型的物理组装于 1967 年 9 月开始，即其首次向世界展示的前一年，距离首次飞行仅 16 个月。当然，所有这一切都需要专门的生产设施才能真正进行。
当波音公司首次公布 747 计划时，这样的工厂并不存在，因此它几乎必须与第一款机型同时建造。萨特为引导该项目及时完成而进行的斗争之一是他的团队将驻扎在哪里。面对发送到加利福尼亚州的提议，萨特表示反对，并坚持要求他的工程师留在那些最终建造飞机的人工作的地方。
事实证明，这里是埃弗雷特，它远不是波音公司最初选择的 747 项目的首选，但由于类似的担忧，即关键人员不会大量迁往其他地方的新设施，该工厂还是占据了上风。无论 747 在哪里建造，都必须建造一座新建筑来容纳如此巨大的飞机以及建造它所需的所有设备。
在与泛美航空协议规定的紧迫期限内，波音公司于 1967 年开始砍伐森林，然后建造该设施。工作在第一架 747 开始组装之前开始，但两项工作重叠，这意味着原型机在一家未完工的工厂中建造了一段时间。当前者最终完工时，它成为世界上体积最大的建筑——这一称号至今仍保留着，也反映了波音公司为启动该项目付出的巨大努力。
当然，这样的努力需要大量的财政支持，而且波音公司冒着巨大的风险才让第一架 747 飞机以这样的速度成功转向。根据与泛美航空的协议，波音公司已获得 5.25 亿美元（即每架飞机 2100 万美元）的融资。这仅占该计划 10 亿美元总成本的一半；然而，根据通货膨胀调整后，今天的数字将超过 100 亿美元。

title_en: Here's How Much Larger The Boeing 737 MAX 7 Is Over The Jet It Directly Replaces
title_zh: 波音 737 MAX 7 比它直接取代的喷气式飞机大了多少
summary: The upgauging Southwest bought with its new short-body 737 MAX.
summary_zh: 不断升级的西南航空公司购买了新型短机身 737 MAX。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

The Boeing 737 MAX 7 finally received airworthiness certification from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on August 3, allowing it to enter production and succeed the legacy 737-700 Next Generation. Aside from being a modernized replacement with better fuel efficiency and superior technology throughout the airframe, the MAX 7 is quite a bit larger than its predecessor. It is essentially the direct result of specific requests from the type's best customer, Southwest Airlines.

Although the MAX 7 first flew in March 2018, its rollout stalled following the 737 MAX groundings. Southwest Airlines holds roughly 237 to 264 firm orders for the Boeing 737 MAX 7, accounting for nearly 90% of the model's entire order book. Since Southwest operates an all-737 fleet and is the world's largest 737 customer, Boeing essentially custom-built the MAX 7's stretched dimensions to keep Southwest from defecting to Airbus.

Adding two rows of seats lowers the cost per seat-mile, making the jet far more profitable on high-frequency domestic routes than a direct size-for-size replacement would have been. Those make the plane six feet longer than the 737-700 NG, while its wingspan is nearly identical, but it weighs over 20,000 lb (10,000 kg) more. It boasts the longest range in the entire 737 MAX lineup as a result of its shorter, lighter airframe using the wing, fuselage center, and gear of the larger 737 MAX 8.
How Southwest Forced Boeing To Redesign The 737 MAX 7

Boeing initially marketed the 737 MAX 7 as a direct, one-for-one replacement for the 737-700, keeping nearly identical length, seat capacity, and layout. However, the heavier CFM LEAP-1B engines added dead-weight drag without increasing passenger capacity. As the launch customer whose massive, single-fleet 737 commitment gave it overwhelming leverage, Southwest was not impressed and threatened defection to the clean-sheet Bombardier CSeries, now the Airbus A220-300. SWA has even joined WestJet in demanding lower seat-mile costs from the smallest member of the 737 MAX line.

In response, Boeing scrapped the original blueprint it debuted at the 2016 Farnborough International Airshow and stretched the fuselage by 76 inches (1.93 meters), adding 30 inches (0.76 meters) forward of the wing box and 46 inches (1.17 meters) aft. That increased the MAX 7's two-class capacity to 153 passengers. Paired with twin LEAP-1B turbofans and larger fuel tanks, the heavier airframe stretched its unrefueled range out to 3,850 nautical miles (7,130 kilometers).

The new cabin gave Southwest a dozen additional revenue-generating seats on every flight without adding cockpit crew. Stretching the fuselage brought the jet's seat-mile costs down to competitive levels. While the 175-seat MAX 8 is Southwest's workhorse on major trunk routes, it is too large to fly profitably multiple times a day on thinner point-to-point routes or off-peak business schedules. Getting Boeing to stretch the MAX 7 gave Southwest A220-level capacity while keeping a 100% 737 fleet.
Resisting The Airbus A220: Why Southwest Stuck With An All-737 Fleet

Certification delays for the 737 MAX 7 left launch customer Southwest Airlines unable to build reliable schedules around its order book of roughly 300 jets meant to replace aging 737-700s. To keep new aircraft arriving, Southwest converted large blocks of slots into 175-seat 737 MAX 8s, creating network imbalances as the larger jets flew half-empty on thinner routes while 25-year-old 737-700s required costly structural overhauls.

During these delays, Airbus saw an opportunity and made a strong pitch for the clean-sheet A220-300. The A220-300 is built with carbon-fiber composite wings, aluminum-lithium fuselage panels, and Pratt & Whitney geared turbofans. Its operating empty weight is about 81,790 pounds (37,100 kilograms), about 17,600 pounds (7,983 kilograms) lighter than Boeing's all-metal MAX 7. This results in a significantly lower trip fuel burn on 130-seat missions.

Despite the A220-300's clean-sheet fuel efficiency, Southwest and Boeing resolved to preserve the carrier's 50-year single-fleet business model. Breaking its all-737 discipline to introduce an Airbus jet would have forced Southwest to build separate pilot training pipelines, split spare-parts inventories, and sacrifice the operational flexibility to swap aircraft seamlessly during weather disruptions.

Boeing optimized the extended MAX 7 to use raw gross weight, range, and seating density to offset the structural advantage of the A220. The MAX 7 provided equivalent seat-mile economics while maintaining uniformity for all pilots, mechanics, and gate crew on a single aircraft family by carrying up to 12 more passengers in high-density single-class layouts and traveling 400 nautical miles (741 kilometers) farther than the A220-300.
MAX 7 Versus MAX 8: How Each Jet Fits Southwest's Flightline

Following its August FAA certification and planned March 2027 passenger debut, the MAX 7 takes over missions from Southwest's nearly 290 retiring 737-700s. Its smaller size relative to the MAX 8 means Southwest can offer multiple daily flights between mid-sized cities without having to cut ticket prices just to fill the plane. The 150-seat-count cabin also lets the airline fly with three flight attendants instead of four, saving on crew costs while still carrying more passengers than its predecessor.

Already numbering over 340 jets in Southwest's active fleet, the MAX 8 is found flying high-demand routes between major focus cities such as Dallas, Denver, Las Vegas, Chicago Midway, and Baltimore. With 175 seats, it delivers the lowest cost per seat-mile in the fleet and maximizes revenue at slot-controlled or congested airports where adding extra daily flights is not possible. Notably, the MAX 7 also handles tough flying conditions better than its bigger sibling.

Pairing the lighter body of the MAX 7 with the MAX 8's wings, engines, and fuel tanks gives it extra climbing power and range. That makes it a great plane for serving fields with short runways or high-altitude airports, or for long trips to Hawaii and the Caribbean, where a heavier MAX 8 might have to leave passengers or bags behind to take off with enough fuel.
How the MAX 7 Powers Southwest’s Shift Toward a New Model

Southwest’s recent transition from a traditional low-cost carrier into a more conventional, legacy-style airline was distinctly marked by ending its 54-year open-seating policy in January. SWA has since added extra-legroom sections, introduced checked bag fees, and is now planning airport lounges. This paradigm shift in the identity of the airline directly shapes how the MAX 7 fits into its network.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
波音 737 MAX 7 终于于 8 月 3 日获得美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的适航认证，使其能够投入生产并接替传统的 737-700 下一代飞机。 MAX 7 是一款现代化的替代机型，具有更好的燃油效率和卓越的机身技术，除此之外，MAX 7 还比其前身大了很多。它本质上是该类型最佳客户西南航空公司特定要求的直接结果。
尽管 MAX 7 于 2018 年 3 月首飞，但在 737 MAX 停飞后，其推出陷入停滞。西南航空持有大约 237 至 264 架波音 737 MAX 7 的确认订单，占该机型全部订单的近 90%。由于西南航空运营着一支全 737 机队，并且是全球最大的 737 客户，因此波音公司基本上定制了 MAX 7 的加长尺寸，以防止西南航空叛逃到空客。
增加两排座位可以降低每座位英里的成本，使得这架飞机在高频次国内航线上的利润远高于直接按尺寸更换的利润。这些使得飞机比 737-700 NG 长六英尺，翼展几乎相同，但重量多出 20,000 磅（10,000 公斤）。它拥有整个 737 MAX 系列中最长的航程，因为其机身更短、更轻，使用了较大 737 MAX 8 的机翼、机身中心和齿轮。
西南航空如何迫使波音重新设计 737 MAX 7

波音最初将 737 MAX 7 作为 737-700 的直接一对一替代品进行营销，保持几乎相同的长度、座位容量和布局。然而，较重的 CFM LEAP-1B 发动机增加了自重阻力，但并未增加载客量。作为启动客户，其庞大的单机队 737 飞机承诺为其带来了压倒性的影响力，西南航空并没有留下深刻的印象，并威胁要转向全新的庞巴迪 CSeries，即现在的空客 A220-300。 SWA 甚至与西捷航空一起要求 737 MAX 系列中最小的成员降低座位英里成本。
作为回应，波音公司放弃了在2016年范堡罗国际航展上首次亮相的原始蓝图，将机身拉长了76英寸（1.93米），翼盒前部增加了30英寸（0.76米），机尾增加了46英寸（1.17米）。这使得 MAX 7 的两级客舱容量增加至 153 名乘客。与双 LEAP-1B 涡轮风扇发动机和更大的油箱配合，较重的机身将其不加油航程延长至 3,850 海里（7,130 公里）。
新客舱为西南航空在每趟航班上增加了十几个创收座位，而无需增加驾驶舱机组人员。拉伸机身使飞机的座英里成本降至有竞争力的水平。虽然拥有 175 个座位​​的 MAX 8 是西南航空在主要干线航线上的主力飞机，但它太大了，无法在稀疏的点对点航线或非高峰业务时刻表上每天多次飞行以实现盈利。让波音扩展 MAX 7 可以让西南航空获得 A220 水平的运力，同时保持 100% 的 737 机队。
抵制空客 A220：为什么西南航空坚持使用全 737 机队
737 MAX 7 的认证延迟导致启动客户西南航空无法为其约 300 架飞机的订单制定可靠的时间表，这些飞机旨在替换老化的 737-700。为了保证新飞机的抵达，西南航空将大量起降时刻改造成 175 座 737 MAX 8 飞机，这造成了网络不平衡，因为大型飞机在狭窄的航线上半空飞行，而机龄 25 年的 737-700 飞机则需要进行昂贵的结构检修。
在这些延误期间，空中客车公司看到了机会，并大力宣传空客 A220-300。 A220-300 采用碳纤维复合材料机翼、铝锂机身面板和普惠齿轮涡轮风扇发动机。其空运行重量约为 81,790 磅（37,100 公斤），比波音全金属 MAX 7 轻约 17,600 磅（7,983 公斤）。这使得 130 座任务的行程燃油消耗显着降低。
尽管 A220-300 的燃油效率非常高，西南航空和波音公司仍决心保留该航空公司 50 年的单一机队商业模式。如果西南航空公司违反其全 737 飞机的规定而引进空客飞机，则将被迫建立单独的飞行员培训管道、分割备件库存，并牺牲在天气干扰期间无缝更换飞机的运营灵活性。
波音公司对加长型 MAX 7 进行了优化，利用原始总重、航程和座位密度来抵消 A220 的结构优势。 MAX 7 提供了同等的座英里经济性，同时保持了单一飞机系列中所有飞行员、机械师和登机口工作人员的一致性，在高密度单舱布局中可多运载 12 名乘客，并且比 A220-300 的飞行距离更远 400 海里（741 公里）。
MAX 7 与 MAX 8：每架喷气式飞机如何适应西南航空的航线
继 8 月获得 FAA 认证并计划于 2027 年 3 月首次亮相后，MAX 7 接替了西南航空近 290 架退役 737-700 的任务。与 MAX 8 相比，其尺寸更小，这意味着西南航空可以在中型城市之间提供每日多个航班，而不必为了装满飞机而降低机票价格。拥有 150 个座位的客舱还允许该航空公司配备三名空乘人员（而不是四名），节省了机组人员成本，同时仍比其前身承载更多乘客。
西南航空现役机队中已有超过 340 架飞机，MAX 8 执飞达拉斯、丹佛、拉斯维加斯、芝加哥中途岛和巴尔的摩等主要重点城市之间的高需求航线。它拥有 175 个座位​​，可在机队中提供最低的每座位英里成本，并在无法增加每日额外航班的受航班时刻控制或拥挤的机场实现收入最大化。值得注意的是，MAX 7 也比其较大的兄弟机型更好地应对恶劣的飞行条件。
MAX 7 较轻的机身与 MAX 8 的机翼、发动机和油箱相结合，赋予其额外的爬升动力和航程。这使得它成为一款出色的飞机，适合为跑道短或高海拔机场提供服务，或者前往夏威夷和加勒比地区进行长途旅行，在这些地方，较重的 MAX 8 可能需要留下乘客或行李才能带着足够的燃料起飞。
MAX 7 如何推动西南航空向新机型转型
西南航空最近从传统的低成本航空公司转型为更传统的传统航空公司，其明显标志是在一月份结束了其长达 54 年的开放座位政策。此后，SWA 增加了额外腿部空间区域，引入了托运行李费，目前正在规划机场休息室。航空公司身份的这种范式转变直接决定了 MAX 7 如何融入其网络。

title_en: The New Changes That Could Make The US Air Force's C-17 Globemasters Become Fighters Instead Of Transport Aircraft
title_zh: 新的变化可能使美国空军的C-17环球霸王成为战斗机而不是运输机
summary: The US Air Force is turning its C-130s and C-17s into missile-launching platforms, giving its cargo aircraft a devastating new strike capabilities
summary_zh: 美国空军正在将其C-130和C-17改造成导弹发射平台，赋予其货机毁灭性的新打击能力
body_en: Chris earned a Master’s degree in Defense and Strategic Studies (Highest Honors) from the University of Texas at El Paso.
His graduate work concentrated on Global and National Security, Low-Intensity Conflict, Modern Warfare, and US grand strategy.
He also undertook extensive regional studies, analyzing how key regions integrate into the broader US security architecture.
This rigorous program provided him with a comprehensive understanding of U.S. military operations, global strategy, and weapons systems.
Additionally, he gained a strong appreciation for great power competition.—an increasingly central force shaping international relations and conflict for the foreseeable future.

The United States Air Force is exploring a concept that could fundamentally change how it generates long-range strike capabilities by turning conventional cargo aircraft into formidable missile-launching platforms. Known initially as Rapid Dragon and now progressing under the Dragon Cart initiative, the program uses specially configured pallets to deploy multiple air-launched cruise missiles from aircraft such as the Lockheed Martin C-130J Super Hercules and Boeing C-17 Globemaster III .

Rather than developing entirely new combat aircraft, the concept leverages the existing air mobility fleet to provide commanders with additional precision-strike capacity. With growing demand for affordable, mass-produced munitions and the need to expand the US military's weapons stockpile, this approach could give the Air Force a significant advantage in future high-intensity conflicts.
"Rapid Dragon": Could A Cargo Aircraft Become a Precision Strike Aircraft?

In 2019, the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) initiated experiments that could, if successful, transform conventional transport aircraft such as the C-17 and C-130 into dual-use aircraft with immense firepower. Once deployed, these cargo haulers will be able to carry significant numbers of rapidly producible cruise missiles and saturate a battlespace, augmenting strike aircraft and heavy bombers.

The AFRL noted that the program has brought together more than "30 stakeholders, including Air Force Major Commands, the Test and Evaluation Enterprise, Program Offices, Mission Planners, other Services, Foreign Partners & Allies, and Industry to develop and demonstrate the capability through modeling, simulation, analysis, demonstration, and flight tests."

The project began as Rapid Dragon and is now known as Dragon Cart. The project tested the possibility of loading palletized munitions, such as JASSM-ER cruise missiles, into C-130s and C-17s. Air & Space Forces Magazine states that the "Rapid Dragon program performed several tests on the C-130 and C-17, including a live-fire test at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, in December 2021." AFRL has also stated that Rapid Dragon has employed the palletized munitions concept on three separate continents, including the EUCOM and INDOPACOM theaters.

According to CENTCOM Citadel , a C-130J Super Hercules can carry two pallets, each containing six missile tubes, enabling the aircraft to deploy up to 12 air-launched cruise missiles. Meanwhile, the C-17 Globemaster III, with a maximum payload capacity of 170,900 lb (77,519 kg), could theoretically accommodate five nine-missile pallets carrying up to 45 JASSMs. This substantial weapons payload could temporarily transform the cargo aircraft into a formidable standoff strike platform.

As demonstrated by Operation Epic Fury , during which US strike aircraft deployed approximately 1,100 JASSMs , from an estimated inventory of 4,400, the need for affordable mass in this category of munitions has become increasingly apparent. Further, the ability to deploy these weapons flexibly would allow US commanders to strike targets without placing additional demands on bomber, fighter, and strike aircraft crews.

Due to the need for an expanded stockpile of missiles, particularly more affordable varieties, Dragon Cart dovetails with the Air Force's investment in its Family of Affordable Mass Missiles (FAMM) program. This initiative is designed to expand the service's munitions stockpile with comparatively inexpensive, less exquisite air-to-ground missiles. To this point, Air&Space Forces Magazine reports that just last July, the "Pentagon announced framework agreements for multiyear deals with three companies to produce and develop two versions of FAMM weapons—FAMM-Lugged, for fighter aircraft, and FAMM-Palletized, for airlifters."

As part of this plan, the Air Force has requested $355 million in its FY2027 budget to procure 1,000 weapons under the broader FAMM program. Its five-year budget projections call for the purchase of 28,000 missiles for $12.6 billion, as detailed by Defence Industry Europe .

The massive buildup of precision missiles will be supported by companies such as Anduril , whose Barracuda cruise missile recently received certification as the Air Force's first large-scale production munition compliant with open systems architecture. This certification provides a clear path forward for the new weapon, which offers commanders greater flexibility, as technicians can swap out payloads and reconfigure other features depending on mission requirements.

Under the FAMM program, Air&Space Forces Magazine states that "Anduril, CoAspire, and Zone 5 Technologies were selected. The agreements call for the three companies to produce 8,000 missiles annually once production ramps up. That timeline targets 5,300 missiles in 2028, rising to 8,000 by 2031." Anduril is slated to deliver its first Barracuda missiles to the Pentagon in early 2027.

With the missiles getting ever closer to delivery and the capability already within the Air Force's grasp, the service is planning to field this new weapon system in 2027, according to Defence Blog . Regarding the impending deployment of the missile delivery system, General Kenneth S. Wilsbach, US Air Force Chief of Staff, stated: “As you might gather, capabilities like FAMM-P blur the distinction between our combat air forces and mobility air force mission sets. That’s a cultural shift we need to be prepared for, and I need every mobility Airman in the room to embrace that change.”

Regarding this blurring of the line between combat and air mobility, this new weapons capability could potentially turn suitably equipped C-130s and C-17s into platforms capable of striking targets across a given theater. Between its active-duty, Air National Guard, and Reserve units, the Air Force operates 428 C-130s and 222 C-17s. That's a substantial number of potential missile-launching platforms. Another consideration is that any adversary will now have to devote resources and plan for the possibility that cargo aircraft operating in the area could be carrying a devastating payload of cruise missiles, placing high-value targets under potential threat.
body_zh: 克里斯在德克萨斯大学埃尔帕索分校获得了国防和战略研究硕士学位（最高荣誉）。
他的研究生工作主要集中在全球和国家安全、低强度冲突、现代战争和美国大战略。
他还进行了广泛的地区研究，分析关键地区如何融入更广泛的美国安全架构。
这个严格的项目使他对美国的军事行动、全球战略和武器系统有了全面的了解。
此外，他对大国竞争产生了强烈的认识——在可预见的未来，这种竞争将成为塑造国际关系和冲突的日益重要的力量。
美国空军正在探索一种概念，通过将传统货机转变为强大的导弹发射平台，可以从根本上改变其产生远程打击能力的方式。该计划最初被称为Rapid Dragon，现在在Dragon Cart计划下取得进展，该计划使用特殊配置的托盘从洛克希德·马丁公司C-130J超级大力士和波音C-17环球霸王III等飞机上部署多枚空射巡航导弹。
该概念不是开发全新的战斗机，而是利用现有的空中机动舰队为指挥官提供额外的精确打击能力。随着对廉价、大规模生产的弹药的需求不断增长，以及扩大美军武器库存的需要，这种方法可能会给空军在未来高强度冲突中带来显着优势。
“急龙”：货机能否成为精确打击机？
2019年，空军研究实验室（AFRL）启动了实验，如果成功，可以将C-17和C-130等传统运输机转变为具有强大火力的两用飞机。一旦部署，这些货运飞机将能够携带大量可快速生产的巡航导弹并饱和战场空间，增强攻击机和重型轰炸机的能力。
AFRL 指出，该计划汇集了“30 多个利益相关者，包括空军主要司令部、测试和评估机构、项目办公室、任务规划者、其他军种、外国合作伙伴和盟友以及工业界，通过建模、模拟、分析、演示和飞行测试来开发和展示这种能力。”

该项目最初称为Rapid Dragon，现在称为Dragon Cart。该项目测试了将 JASSM-ER 巡航导弹等托盘弹药装载到 C-130 和 C-17 上的可能性。 《空军与太空部队》杂志指出，“快速龙计划对 C-130 和 C-17 进行了多次测试，包括 2021 年 12 月在佛罗里达州埃格林空军基地进行的实弹测试。” AFRL 还表示，Rapid Dragon 已在三个不同的大陆采用了托盘弹药概念，其中包括 EUCOM 和 INDOPACOM 战区。

据 CENTCOM Citadel 称，一架 C-130J Super Hercules 可以携带两个托盘，每个托盘包含六个导弹管，使飞机能够部署多达 12 枚空射巡航导弹。与此同时，C-17 Globemaster III 的最大有效载荷为 170,900 磅（77,519 公斤），理论上可容纳 5 个可装载 9 枚导弹的托盘，最多可携带 45 枚 JASSM。这种巨大的武器有效载荷可以暂时将货机转变为强大的防区外打击平台。
正如“史诗狂怒”行动所证明的那样，美国攻击机在该行动中部署了大约 1,100 枚 JASSM（估计库存为 4,400 枚），对此类弹药的价格合理的需求已变得越来越明显。此外，灵活部署这些武器的能力将使美国指挥官能够打击目标，而不会对轰炸机、战斗机和攻击机机组人员提出额外要求。
由于需要扩大导弹库存，特别是更便宜的品种，“龙车”与空军对其廉价大规模导弹系列（FAMM）计划的投资相吻合。这一举措旨在通过相对便宜、不太精致的空对地导弹来扩大军种的弹药库存。对此，《空军与太空力量杂志》报道称，就在去年 7 月，“五角大楼宣布与三家公司达成多年协议，以生产和开发两种版本的 FAMM 武器——用于战斗机的 FAMM-Lugged 和用于运输机的 FAMM-Palletized。”
作为该计划的一部分，空军已在 2027 财年预算中申请 3.55 亿美元，用于在更广泛的 FAMM 计划下采购 1,000 件武器。据欧洲防务工业公司详细介绍，其五年预算预计需要花费 126 亿美元购买 28,000 枚导弹。
精确导弹的大规模建设将得到 Anduril 等公司的支持，其 Barracuda 巡航导弹最近获得了空军第一种符合开放系统架构的大规模生产弹药的认证。该认证为新武器的发展提供了明确的道路，为指挥官提供了更大的灵活性，因为技术人员可以根据任务要求更换有效载荷并重新配置其他功能。
根据 FAMM 计划，《Air&Space Forces Magazine》指出“Anduril、CoAspire 和 Zone 5 Technologies 被选中。协议要求这三家公司在产量增加后每年生产 8,000 枚导弹。该时间表的目标是到 2028 年生产 5,300 枚导弹，到 2031 年增加到 8,000 枚。”安杜里尔计划于 2027 年初向五角大楼交付第一批梭子鱼导弹。
据《防务博客》报道，随着导弹越来越接近交付，而且空军已经掌握了这种能力，空军计划在 2027 年部署这种新型武器系统。关于即将部署的导弹发射系统，美国空军参谋长肯尼思·S·威尔斯巴赫将军表示：“正如你所料，像 FAMM-P 这样的能力模糊了我们作战空军和机动空军任务集之间的区别。这是我们需要做好准备的文化转变，我需要在场的每一位机动空军士兵都接受这一变化。”
鉴于战斗和空中机动之间界限的模糊，这种新的武器能力有可能将适当装备的 C-130 和 C-17 转变为能够打击特定战区目标的平台。空军拥有现役、空军国民警卫队和预备役部队 428 架 C-130 和 222 架 C-17。这是大量潜在的导弹发射平台。另一个考虑因素是，任何对手现在都必须投入资源并针对在该地区运行的货机可能携带毁灭性巡航导弹的可能性进行计划，从而使高价值目标面临潜在威胁。

title_en: Russia opens investigation after An-12 military crash kills 19 in Siberia
title_zh: 俄罗斯对An-12在西伯利亚军事坠机造成19人死亡展开调查
summary: Russian military investigators say they have opened a criminal investigation after an Antonov An-12 transport aircraft crashed near… The post Russia opens investigation after An-12 military crash kills 19 in Siberia appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 俄罗斯军事调查人员表示，一架安东诺夫 An-12 运输机在附近坠毁后，他们已展开刑事调查。
body_en: Russian military investigators say they have opened a criminal investigation after an Antonov An-12 transport aircraft crashed near Kemerovo in southwestern Siberia on November 17, 2026, killing all 19 people aboard.

Russian media outlets reported that the aircraft had been flying from Novosibirsk to Kansk when one of its engines reportedly caught fire. The crew requested an emergency landing at Kemerovo Airport but crashed several miles short of the runway. Witnesses on the ground said the airplane was on fire before it crashed.

Russia’s Defense Ministry said the aircraft was conducting a routine flight when it went down in an unpopulated area near the village of Yagunovo. The ministry identified a “technical malfunction” as the preliminary explanation but did not specify what went wrong. A Russian Aerospace Forces commission is examining the accident.

The Investigative Committee said military investigators opened the case under Article 351 of Russia’s criminal code, which covers violations of flight rules or preparations for flight. Its announcement confirmed that all crew members and passengers died.

Kemerovo Governor Ilya Seredyuk visited the scene and said emergency crews had extinguished the fire. Authorities cordoned off the area and established an operations headquarters for investigators, rescue services and emergency medical personnel.
Investigators continued examining the crash site on November 18 and collecting evidence for forensic analysis, the newspaper reported.
Authorities have not publicly identified the victims or provided a confirmed breakdown of crew and passengers.
The An-12 is a Soviet-designed, four-engine turboprop transport aircraft that entered service in the late 1950s. More than 1,000 were built, and examples remain in military and civilian service.
The registration, age and operating unit of the aircraft involved in the crash have not been confirmed.

body_zh: 俄罗斯军事调查人员表示，2026 年 11 月 17 日，一架安东诺夫 An-12 运输机在西伯利亚西南部克麦罗沃附近坠毁，机上 19 人全部遇难，他们已对此展开刑事调查。
俄罗斯媒体报道称，这架飞机从新西伯利亚飞往坎斯克时，其中一台发动机起火。机组人员请求在克麦罗沃机场紧急降落，但在距离跑道几英里的地方坠毁。地面目击者称，飞机坠毁前已起火。
俄罗斯国防部表示，这架飞机在亚古诺沃村附近的无人区坠毁时正在进行例行飞行。该部初步解释是“技术故障”，但没有具体说明问题所在。俄罗斯航空航天部队委员会正在调查这起事故。
调查委员会表示，军事调查人员根据俄罗斯刑法第351条立案，该条涵盖违反飞行规则或飞行准备的行为。其公告证实，所有机组人员和乘客均已死亡。
克麦罗沃州州长伊利亚·谢雷杜克（Ilya Seredyuk）视察了现场，并表示紧急救援人员已将火扑灭。当局封锁了该地区，并为调查人员、救援服务和紧急医疗人员设立了行动总部。
据该报报道，调查人员于 11 月 18 日继续检查坠机现场并收集证据进行法医分析。
当局尚未公开遇难者身份，也没有提供确认的机组人员和乘客详细情况。
An-12 是苏联设计的四引擎涡轮螺旋桨运输机，于 20 世纪 50 年代末投入使用。共生产了 1,000 多辆，还有一些样车仍在军事和民用领域服役。
失事飞机的注册、机龄和运营单位尚未确认。

body_en: Lufthansa opens bookings for new 2–2 business seats on A320s - Aviation24.be
Home Airbus Airbus A320 Family Lufthansa opens bookings for new 2–2 business seats on A320s

Lufthansa has opened bookings for its new Premium Business Seat on flights from Frankfurt to Athens, Nice and Cairo from 1 March 2027. The airline will initially install eight seats on each of six Airbus A320ceos as a commercial trial.

The seats will occupy the first two rows in a 2–2 layout , with a pitch of almost one metre. Each will have an adjustable backrest, integrated leg rest and footrest, a fold-out table and additional storage.

The first retrofitted aircraft is scheduled to enter service on various routes from 16 December 2026 . Lufthansa plans to assign the aircraft permanently to the three launch routes from February, ahead of the March start date for bookable seat reservations.

Business-class passengers can select the seat during booking or add it later through seat reservation, with the applicable conditions displayed during the process. Lufthansa will assess demand and different booking options before deciding whether to expand the offering.
The six aircraft will also receive Lufthansa Group’s new Starlink-powered Wi-Fi during the retrofit, supporting streaming, cloud-based work and other applications requiring a high-speed connection.

汉莎航空已于 2027 年 3 月 1 日起在从法兰克福飞往雅典、尼斯和开罗的航班上开放其新型高级商务座椅的预订。作为商业试验，该航空公司最初将在六架空客 A320ceo 上每架安装 8 个座位。
座位将占据前两排，呈2-2布局，间距近一米。每间都配有可调节靠背、一体式腿托和脚踏板、折叠桌和额外的存储空间。
首架改装飞机计划于 2026 年 12 月 16 日起在多条航线上投入使用。汉莎航空计划从 2 月份开始，在 3 月份可预订座位的开始日期之前，将这架飞机永久分配到这 3 条启动航线。
公务舱旅客可以在预订时选择座位，也可以稍后通过座位预订添加座位，过程中会显示适用条件。汉莎航空将评估需求和不同的预订选项，然后再决定是否扩大服务范围。
在改装期间，这六架飞机还将接收汉莎集团全新的星链支持的 Wi-Fi，支持流媒体、基于云的工作和其他需要高速连接的应用程序。
